author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, GPay
job_description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 7 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from concept to launch.
* Experience with Growth in a fast paced environment (especially in Consumer facing Mobile first areas).
* Experience and interest in building large-scale platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

As a Product Manager leading the Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals within Google Pay (GPay) India, you will own the overall direction, strategy, and execution for two of GPay's highest-frequency engagement drivers. In this role, you will define end-to-end product roadmaps across daily-commute transit experiences as well as Mobile Recharge product strategy and growth across - Platform, AI experiences, UX, performance and more. You will serve as the core strategic owner bridging product innovation, internal cross-functional execution (Engineering, UX, Analytics, Legal, Business Development), and critical external ecosystem partnerships with Telecom companies, Aggregators, regulators, public transport operators, and more to scale daily and monthly usage and engagement amongst users across India.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals on GPay India, translating complex daily utility needs and regulatory standards into intuitive, high-scale GPay experiences.
* Lead the end to end product portfolio across Growth, Platformization, Scalability, Reliability, Obsersability, AI experiences and new opportunities at massive scale.
* Lead buildout of the Transit space on GPay —driving initiatives across NCMC, QR Ticketing and other first-party and third-party experiences.
* Establish a close working relationship with key ecosystem partners (NPCI, Bharat Connect, aggregators, issuers and others) to navigate compliance , unblock technical dependencies, and lead cross-functional growth tracks to eliminate funnel friction and maximize user engagement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role and Team:**

A hybrid Product Manager role embedded within the Data Science team. You'll own the product direction for ML-driven capabilities — bidding algorithms, traffic quality (fraud detection), and audience modeling — while maintaining the operational rigor required for MRC/TAG compliance. You'll be part of the broader PM community, following established practices and gradually expanding your scope.

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**

**Product Management**

* Own and prioritize the Data Science team backlog; define user stories and acceptance criteria
* Lead scopes where domain knowledge is primarily algorithm/ML-driven; support cross team scopes as a secondary PM
* Participate in roadmap planning, sprint planning, and PM syncs, and uphold established PM ways of working — from templates and documentation standards to consistent communication and proactive
* stakeholder management
* Bridge Product leadership and Data Scientists — translate business needs into technical priorities and vice versa  
    
  **Algorithm Analysis & Validation**
* Analyze and validate ML algorithm outputs (bidding, delivery predictions, audience models) against business KPIs
* Test model outputs, identify when and why algorithms underperform, and provide actionable feedback to data scientists
* Conduct advanced investigation and analysis for algorithm-related performance issues
* Support A/B test design and analysis for algorithm changes  
    
  **Ad & Traffic Quality (Fraud) Operations**
* Investigate fraud-related issues — IP/domain/app unblocking, ads.txt issues, discrepancy reports, DOOH/CTV/Retail Media whitelisting
* Manage fraud blacklists (IP, domain, UA, app) using internal tools
* Run compliance cycles — Backward Looking Assessments, quarterly risk assessments, IVT filter reviews,
* TAG/IWL list updates, methodology disclosures — and look for opportunities to AI automate the recurring,
* Repeatable parts rather than only running them manually
* Support TAG/MRC audits and contribute to RFI/RFP responses on traffic quality  
    
  **Industry & AI Awareness**
* Track AdTech trends, AI/ML developments, and competitive landscape to inform priorities

**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**

* 3–5 years in a product, analytics, or technical role working alongside data science/ML teams
* 1–2 years of experience in AdTech or programmatic advertising
* Hands-on experience testing or analyzing ML model outputs (not building them)
* Strong analytical skills — SQL, data analysis tools, basic statistics
* Solid product fundamentals — backlog management, stakeholder alignment, acceptance criteria
* Excellent communication — can explain algorithm behavior to non-technical stakeholders

**Stand out by having:**

* Comfort working in an AI-native way — using LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate analysis, drafting, and
* Investigation, and a sense for where recurring workflows can be automated rather than just executed
* Familiarity with ad fraud / IVT concepts and MRC/TAG standards
* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
* Python/R for data exploration

**Our promise to you:**

* A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues

* Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family

* 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

* Paid maternity (6 months) and paternity (2 weeks)

* Annual learning budget to help you grow your skills and support continuous learning

* Rewarding referral program for helping us grow

* Global perks such as birthday gifts, work anniversaries, and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun

* And much more – join us to explore the full experience

**Diversity & Inclusion @Adform:**

Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Product Management Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will: • Identify, analyze and interpret business data using various kinds of techniques to meet business needs and requirements. • Activate the connective tissue between U.S. Bank, customer experience, digital, technology, and business line strategy to identify and prioritize product / portfolio opportunities, and establish the product vision, charter and roadmap. • Defines product outcomes and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to prioritize Features/Epics and breaks down work into actionable steps to facilitate product discovery, design, development and delivery. • Manages the end-to-end product lifecycle and drives the product roadmap leveraging OKRs (Objectives and Key Results). Creates the product in conjunction with agile, experience design, technology and risk partners to achieve business and customer outcomes. In the case of technical products, understands and cares for the technical features, debt reduction and modernization of the technical product with expertise in the technology required of the product. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills: • Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators, design systems, service blueprints, and reusability. • Ability to anticipate shifting market priorities, internal and external customer needs in a manner that consistently adds value. • Strong customer centricity to implement strategies and techniques used to ensure that customers have a positive experience with the organization's products and services at every touch point. • Knowledge of technical aspects of software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products. • Knowledge of Agile ways of working, knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations. • Preferred skills: product PnL, product strategy, vision and planning, product discovery, product development, channel alignment and management, adoption, customer experience research, insight and execution, agile ways of working, go to market and sales channels, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics, customer centricity. Minimum Qualifications: • Product management experience

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

author: Hiring Manager
title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.  
  
Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

* Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
* Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
* Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
* Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

#### **The Role:**

We’re looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, not features. Our team — including product admins and student success managers — handles a large and growing workload, and much of it is still manual: watching customer Slack channels, cross-referencing Google Sheets, catching escalations late, onboarding our students etc. Your job is to design the product and infrastructure that takes that load off people so they can focus on the work that actually matters.  
  
You’ll own the full picture: how the dashboard and interface fit together, how information flows between systems, and where AI can quietly do the heavy lifting. The bar is simple — every feature you ship should make someone’s day easier, never add cognitive load.  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who is product-minded with a real technical sense. Not a pure PM who hands off specs, and not a pure developer — someone who can talk to a user, sketch the flow in Figma, build a working prototype in Dify or n8n, and judge whether the result is genuinely good to use.

#### **What you’ll do**

* **Own the end-to-end experience.** Design the dashboard and interface as a coherent whole, not a collection of features. Understand how each screen, workflow, and data point connects, and keep the system simple as it grows.
* **Design for real users under real load.** Observe how team members work, find friction and repetitive effort, and design flows that streamline high-volume work. UX quality is a core deliverable, not a finishing touch.
* **Use AI to remove work, not create it.** Identify where LLMs, RAG, and automation can take tasks off people’s plates — triage, summarization, flagging, routing, follow-ups — and design those capabilities so they feel invisible and trustworthy.
* **Build a unified view of the customer journey.** Integrate conversations from customer Slack channels with our core applications and Google Sheets so the team sees one picture instead of many.
* **Make service proactive.** Build systems that automatically flag and triage customer escalations before they become critical, and that help student success managers identify at-risk clients and trigger timely, automated follow-ups.
* **Prototype and verify quickly.** Use Dify.AI to build LLM-powered prototypes, implement RAG, and iterate on prompts; use n8n to orchestrate automated workflows across third-party apps and APIs. Validate ideas with working prototypes before committing engineering time.
* **Lead AI product design.** Prompt engineering, model selection and configuration, interaction design for AI features, and an evaluation framework that tells us whether an AI feature is actually working.
* **Run on data.** Monitor product and AI-effect metrics, analyze user behavior, identify pain points, and drive continuous iteration.
* **Stay current.** Track developments in AI tooling (Dify, n8n, Coze, and others), analyze competitors, and bring what’s useful back into our product.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Contribute to short-term product planning and offer well-reasoned input on product strategy and technical direction.

#### **What we’re looking for**

* **2–5 years of product management experience**, including 1–3 years designing AI-powered products.
* **Strong UI/UX judgment.** You understand information architecture, interaction design, and how to design for people doing high-volume work. You can tell the difference between “has the feature” and “is pleasant to use,” and you care about the difference. Proficient with Figma, Axure, or similar.
* **Solid AI product fundamentals.** Deep understanding of how LLM applications work; practical experience with prompt engineering and RAG; able to independently design, evaluate, and optimize an AI feature and balance technical feasibility against user experience.
* **Hands-on with AI tooling.** Real-world experience with Dify.AI, n8n, or comparable platforms — you build, not just specify.

Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.  
  
Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

* Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
* Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
* Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
* Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We’re looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, not features. author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

The SAFe **Product Manager,** Software leads the definition, prioritization, and execution of software and digital investments for an Agile Release Train (ART) in the **Power and Motion Business Portfolio** . You will be the primary connection between business strategy, customer and user needs, and software engineering execution, translating market opportunities and stakeholder requirements into actionable roadmaps, features, and release priorities. You will collaborate with commercial, product, architecture, engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and program leadership teams to guide investment decisions and ensure delivery of customer and business value.

You will report to the SAFe Team Lead and will work a hybrid schedule based in Pune, India.

  
  

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Develop and own the feature backlog and roadmap for software development according to portfolio priorities
* Manage alignment between Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), software architecture, and the Agile Release Train feature backlog
* Work with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to set implementation direction and balance priorities
* Coordinate with stakeholders outside the business segment on integration plans, dependencies, and release alignment with connected products and platforms
* Work with development teams to remove implementation barriers and coordinate resolution of technical, dependency, and delivery issues with the necessary stakeholders
* Guide the ART in achieving predictable, high-quality objectives by responding to issues, making timely decisions, and supporting release readiness
* Develop intuitive familiarity with the software portfolio, architecture, technology, R&D, customer workflows, and market factors to collaborate across technical and commercial teams
* Manage several simultaneous initiatives related to the effectiveness and flow of the Agile Release Train
* Support implementation of the global business unit product strategy and Annual Operating Plan
* Partner with Product Management to resolve complex internal and external customer problems with broad, long-term effects, responding with urgency and delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions
  

  

### **The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field
* Willing to travel up to 10%
  

  

### **The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience
* In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies and techniques, with experience supporting or leading an Agile Release Train
* Knowledge of industrial automation products and the software ecosystems that configure, connect, monitor, or support them
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation software, variable frequency drive, or motion product portfolios is highly desired
* Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, product management, software engineering, architecture, quality, and program teams
* Demonstrated success working within a global matrix environment to achieve multiple simultaneous goals
* Ability to communicate complex technical and business information clearly to multiple levels of stakeholders
* Understanding of business profit and loss responsibility
  

  

### **What We Offer:**

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programmes through OnTrack
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* Other local benefits

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-HR1

  
  
  

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

job_description:
**Product Manager – Ad Decisioning Enablement**  
  
**Roundel, Target’s Retail Media Network**  
  
**About us**  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  
  
**Team Overview**  
  
Roundel is Target’s retail media network, helping brands connect with millions of Target guests through relevant, measurable, and guest-centered advertising experiences.  
  
As retail media continues to grow, advertisers are looking for smarter ways to plan, activate, optimize, and measure their investments. Roundel is investing in next-generation intelligence products that help teams and advertisers make better media decisions across channels, campaign stages, and business objectives.  
  
We are looking for a **Product Manager** to lead a high-impact area focused on **ad-inventory forecasting** and **ad-relevance** capabilities  
  
In this role, you will shape capabilities that enable our ad-decisioning engine elevate customer experience and deliver advertiser outcomes. This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and building systems that translate complex signals into decision drivers  
  
You will partner closely with data science, engineering, analytics, and product teams to define the strategy, roadmap, and execution for capabilities that help Roundel deliver more effective, and measurable advertising outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll do**

  

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for ad-inventory forecasting and ad-relevance.
* Working at the intersection of data, AI, and business, you’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, and partner teams to design scalable systems and intelligent models.
* Collaborate with sales, GTM and other product teams to ensure these products translate into real-world value for advertisers, and to continuously refine based on adoption, performance, and market feedback.
* As part of Roundel, Target’s retail media business, play a pivotal role in advancing the sophistication of our forecasting, optimization, and recommendation engines.
* Influence how advertisers plan, invest, and win on Target’s platform — impacting both advertiser success and Target’s bottom line.

**What we’re looking for**

  

* Experience: 4+ years of Product Management, ideally with a focus on data-driven, optimization, or AI/ML-powered products in adtech, martech, or related fields.
* Technical fluency: Comfortable working with data science, machine learning, experimentation, or AI-driven systems; able to bridge technical depth with business application.
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of retail media networks, digital advertising ecosystems, or media buying workflows is a strong plus.
* Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to partner with data engineers, scientists, API developers, and commercial teams to bring complex products to market.
* Analytical strength: Skilled at interpreting large datasets, validating accuracy, and turning complex signals into actionable decisions.
* AI curiosity: Experience (or strong interest) in GenAI/agentic AI and applying emerging technologies to improve forecasting, optimization, and recommendations.
* Strategic mindset: Able to set product vision, establish OKRs, and drive execution across multiple dependencies in a fast-moving space.
* Influence & storytelling: Excellent communicator who can distil technical complexity into compelling narratives for sales, advertisers, and executives.
* Organized & adaptable: Adept at managing priorities, navigating ambiguity, and iterating quickly based on feedback and results.
* A bias for action, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a passion for building products that create measurable impact.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

---------------

This role is responsible for managing assigned AI product modules and feature areas by translating business requirements into actionable user stories, prioritised backlogs, and sprint-ready requirements. * Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and data science teams to refine requirements, assess feasibility, and support timely delivery of AI-driven capabilities.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, document functional needs, and ensure alignment between business objectives and product implementation.
* Define feature-level success metrics, acceptance criteria, and quality measures to track progress and evaluate product outcomes.
* Support user acceptance testing, release readiness, and deployment activities to ensure successful delivery of product enhancements.
* Analyse product usage data, stakeholder feedback, and operational insights to identify opportunities for product improvements and backlog refinement.
* Create and maintain product documentation, release notes, functional specifications, and stakeholder communications for assigned product areas.
* Support Responsible AI, compliance, and governance requirements by incorporating defined standards, evaluation criteria, and documentation requirements into product development activities.
* Stay updated on AI, GenAI, and emerging technology trends to contribute ideas for future product enhancements and innovation opportunities.

### **Basic Information**

Travel

Looking for details about our benefits?

### **Description and Requirements**

Hybrid: #LI-Hybrid

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.

**Job Description:**

The Lead Product Manager for the AMI Operations Portfolio is responsible for defining and driving the product strategy, roadmap, and commercial success of BMC's AMI Operations solutions for mainframe environments. This role serves as the primary product leader for operational capabilities that help customers improve availability, performance, automation, observability, and operational efficiency across their mainframe infrastructure. The position requires deep expertise in mainframe operations, customer workflows, market trends, and emerging AI-driven operational practices. The Lead Product Manager partners closely with engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, professional services, and executive leadership to deliver innovative solutions that address customer challenges and support portfolio growth.

  

Key responsibilities include:

* Define and drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for the AMI Operations portfolio.

* Serve as a primary product management leader and subject matter expert for mainframe operations solutions.

* Engage directly with customers, user groups, and advisory boards to identify market needs and validate product direction.

* Translate customer requirements, market trends, and competitive insights into product strategy and actionable roadmaps.

* Lead the adoption of AI, automation, observability, and operational intelligence capabilities across the portfolio.

* Partner with engineering teams to prioritize requirements and deliver high-value product releases.

* Own business cases, market opportunities, and product investment recommendations.

* Drive cross-functional alignment among engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, support, and professional services.

* Support go-to-market activities, product launches, sales enablement, and strategic customer engagements.

* Monitor business performance, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and portfolio growth to ensure achievement of revenue and strategic objectives.

**Dev Skill Needs:**

* Product management leadership for enterprise software and SaaS platforms.

* Strong understanding of AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and autonomous systems.

* Experience with observability, automation, AIOps, or IT operations platforms.

* Strong knowledge of mainframe operations, systems management, or enterprise infrastructure.

* Data-driven decision making and product analytics expertise.

* Experience defining platform APIs, integrations, and ecosystem strategies.

* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

* Demonstrated ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept to launch.

CA-DNP

**Our commitment to you!**

  

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

  
  

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

  

BMC is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, age, sex, creed, color, religion, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy, disabled veteran or status as a protected veteran. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.

BMC Software maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.

At BMC we believe in pay transparency and have set the midpoint of the salary band for this role at 4,700,000 INR. Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

  
  

The salary listed is just one component of BMC's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.

  
  

We are committed to ensuring that our employees are paid fairly and equitably, and that we are transparent about our compensation practices.

(**Returnship@BMC**)

Had a break in your career? No worries. This role is eligible for candidates who have taken a break in their career and want to re-enter the workforce. If your expertise matches the above job, visit to https://bmcrecruit.avature.net/returnship know more and how to apply.

5,875,000

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

text:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager.

This role sits at the core of CIB’s AI transformation agenda, shaping the roadmap, governance, implementation, and scaling of next‑generation AI/GenAI capabilities across business lines. You will drive strategic assessments, integrate AI solutions into key workflows, ensure risk‑aligned delivery, and partner closely with senior leadership to execute high‑impact innovation initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead the development and execution of complex digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have impact across the enterprise with broad impact
* Act as key participant in large-scale planning
* Review and analyze complex digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area
* Influence digital strategy for the business line requiring in-depth evaluation of multiple factors including intangibles or unprecedented factors
* Make decisions in digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area requiring strong understanding of the business, policies, procedures and/or compliance requirements
* Lead a broad team of digital professionals to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and mid-level to senior managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Potentially lead projects, teams or serve as a peer mentor

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in **transformation, product management, business analysis, business execution, and AI solution delivery**
* Deep knowledge of **Corporate & Investment Banking** products, workflows, and asset classes.
* Hands-on experience in **AI/GenAI** solution development and enterprise implementation.
* Strong proficiency with modern AI stacks (Lang Chain, Lang Graph, MCP), GenAI lifecycle processes, and model optimization techniques.
* Experience with **agentic AI**, workflow automation, document intelligence, and intelligent routing.
* Ability to operate across complex organizational structures with excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills.
* Proven leadership experience, including team guidance, decision‑making, and strategic problem‑solving. Skilled in defining target‑state blueprints and actionable roadmaps.

**Job Expectations**

Ability to manage multiple high‑complexity initiatives with significant cross‑functional impact. Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills (JIRA, Confluence).Comfortable driving change and influencing senior stakeholders in a dynamic, evolving transformation environment.

**AI & Innovation Delivery**

Lead and execute AI/GenAI initiatives aligned with CIB strategic priorities, from idea validation to deployment. Integrate AI solutions across key CIB journeys—Client, Vendor, Market, Lending—to improve efficiency, decisioning, and servicing experiences.

**Strategy, Governance & Execution**

Conduct strategic reviews, evaluate performance, and solve complex business challenges with structured frameworks and creative problem‑solving. Define and implement processes, procedures, success metrics, and lifecycle standards for AI/ML and agentic workflows.Ensure compliance with CIB and enterprise methodologies, AI governance, AIRR controls, and risk frameworks.

**Program & Stakeholder Leadership**

Lead end‑to‑end program management for high‑visibility innovation initiatives, including scope definition, execution planning, resource management, and stakeholder alignment. Collaborate with cross‑functional leaders across Technology, Product, Business Execution, Risk, and Data to drive delivery and manage dependencies.Mentor and guide junior staff across Strategy & Execution and Innovation teams.

**AI Architecture & Technical Understanding**

Apply practical understanding of LLM workflows, chunking, RAG, hallucination mitigation, vectorization, and prompt engineering. Utilize modern AI tooling (LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol) to support scalable, context-aware AI solutions. Partner with technical teams on cloud, data, integration design, document intelligence, and agentic orchestration.

**Posting End Date:**

19 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

job_description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**What you will do?**

* Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Ads personalization & targeting across Glance surfaces
* Generate insights that reshape targeting strategy and surface new growth levers. Build products that help identify high-value targeting opportunities and next best actions across audiences, contextual signals, products, categories, and surfaces.
* Translate business goals into ML problem statements: define features, labels, training data, and success metrics for models to deliver advertiser KPIs
* Act as the primary product stakeholder for experimentation design, metrics definition, and guardrails spanning engagement, ad metrics and advertiser KPIs. Build the feedback loop from auction and ad-serving outcomes back into model training and targeting strategy
* Work closely with Tech and ML teams to shape ads recommendation framework and create execution plans to ensure timely delivery of high-quality outputs
* Enhance monetization efficiency through ML algorithms such as dynamic floor pricing

**What We're Looking For:**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in AdTech, AI/ML products, recommendation systems, decisioning platforms, or digital advertising.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including targeting, ad serving, auctions, bidding, pricing, yield optimization, and advertiser KPIs.
* Strong understanding of ML-driven targeting, ranking/recommendation, audience segmentation, contextual signals, and personalization, with the ability to translate business problems into ML problem statements.
* Highly data-driven, with experience defining metrics, designing experiments, and building feedback loops to optimize both user engagement and advertiser outcomes.
* Strong product sense with experience owning strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and end-to-end execution for complex, data-intensive products.
* Comfortable partnering deeply with Engineering, ML/Data Science, Ads, and Business teams to drive decisions and deliver high-quality products at scale.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.

The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of high-impact digital, AI, and automation products that improve processes across Client Services. This role will identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities, guide technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

The ideal candidate is a skilled product manager with deep product management experience, strong technical fluency, and demonstrated success applying rigorous critical thinking to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems. They have experience building and scaling AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for high-impact digital, AI, and automation products across a defined product area or process domain within Client Services, including discovery, user research, business-case development, requirements definition, prioritization, responsible AI and risk controls, experimentation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across business, product, technology, operations, design, risk, legal, compliance, and regional teams; influence stakeholders and resolve trade-offs to maintain delivery momentum.
* Develop fluency in the payments ecosystem and Client Services capabilities, workflows, systems, data, controls, and operational dependencies to inform product strategy and execution across multiple process areas.
* Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs; monitor adoption, user experience, operational performance, model quality, risk, and value realization; and use data and feedback to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
* Apply rigorous critical thinking and systems thinking to ambiguous, complex, and multi-dependency Client Services challenges: frame problems, test assumptions, synthesize qualitative and quantitative evidence, evaluate alternatives and risks, make sound product decisions, and clearly articulate the rationale and expected business impact.
* Lead the development of AI-enabled and automated products in partnership with engineering including use-case selection, determining appropriate AI, automation, and human-intervention patterns, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Shape and deliver digital platform capabilities and workflow solutions that translate complex client and operational processes into intuitive, scalable product experiences, spanning requirements intake, solution design, decisioning, validation, approvals, integrations, execution, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate product strategy, investment rationale, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to senior stakeholders and leadership, escalating to executive sponsors as needed.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

5 or more years of relevant product management experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 3 or more years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including end-to-end ownership of complex digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and optimization.

* Required: Demonstrated critical-thinking, analytical judgment, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently frame ambiguous business problems, challenge assumptions, evaluate qualitative and quantitative evidence, assess options and risks, and translate insights into product strategy, decisions, and clear requirements.
* Required: Demonstrated experience using AI technologies to build products, including identifying viable use cases, creating or directing prototypes, defining data and model requirements, establishing evaluation and success metrics, partnering with engineering to productionize solutions, and applying responsible AI, privacy, security, and human-oversight practices. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.

**Product Manager – Life Sciences**

**Company:** Ross Biotech Private Limited  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years

**Job Description:**

Ross Biotech is looking for a dynamic and technically strong Product Manager / Application Manager to manage our Life Science and Scientific Instrumentation product portfolio.

The candidate will be responsible for product management, customer mapping, lead identification, lead qualification, application support, and coordination with international principals to develop business opportunities and expand market presence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage assigned product portfolios and develop product-wise business strategies.
* Identify and map potential customers in the genomics, proteomics, immunology, cell biology, bioassay or related research areas.
* Generate new business leads and qualify opportunities based on customer requirements.
* Understand customer applications and recommend suitable products and solutions.
* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and technical discussions.
* Coordinate with customers and sales teams for product evaluations and business development.
* Manage relationships and regular communication with international principals.
* Coordinate with principals for product training, technical support, and new product launches.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and new business opportunities.
* Support the sales team in technical discussions and opportunity conversion.
* Prepare monthly business reports, lead reports, and product performance updates.
* Report directly to the Director and achieve assigned KPIs.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New customer identification and customer mapping.
* Qualified lead generation and opportunity development.
* Product-wise business pipeline development.
* Product presentations and customer demonstrations.
* Principal coordination and relationship management.
* Application support and customer satisfaction.
* Contribution towards business growth and revenue targets.
* Timely submission of monthly performance reports.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or a related field.
* 4–8 years of experience in Product Management, Application Management, or Scientific Instrumentation.
* Strong account management and business development skills in liquid handling workflows, extraction reagents, biobanking.
* Good knowledge of life science products and laboratory applications.
* Experience in customer mapping, lead generation, and business development.
* Strong technical presentation and communication skills.
* Experience coordinating with international principals will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of MS Office and Excel.
* Willingness to travel for customer visits and business development activities.

**Interested Candidates**

Please share your updated resume at:

**hr@rossbiotech.com**

Join Ross Biotech and be part of our growing team in the Life Sciences and Biopharmaceutical industry!

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Role Description:

**About the team**
------------------

FinTech is an ever-changing, complex, competitive, and extremely exciting industry. More than ever before, in order to accomplish Booking.com's mission ("making it easier for everyone to experience the world"), we need to offer world-class payment experiences and financial products on both sides of our marketplace. Do you want to play a part in that journey?

Join us in Bangalore as a Product Manager on the Partner Master Data track within FinTech Foundations, and help us build the single source of truth for Financial Partner Master Data (FPMD) that powers onboarding, payouts, invoicing, and compliance across every Booking Holdings brand.

**About the role**
------------------

Join the Partner Master Data team within FinTech Foundations and help build a trusted source of partner and property data used across Booking Holdings. This foundation supports critical experiences and operations—including partner onboarding, payouts, invoicing and compliance. You’ll own one or more product areas, working within the track’s broader strategy and with guidance from senior product leaders.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the roadmap and delivery for your product area, turning business and compliance needs into clear requirements and a prioritized backlog.
* Work with stakeholders to map how partner data is captured, governed and used across upstream and downstream systems.
* Improve the quality of critical data by defining and tracking measures such as completeness, validity, consistency and timeliness, and partnering on remediation.
* Identify risks and dependencies early—including data ownership across teams and brands—and work with Engineering and partners to address them.
* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, decisions, risks and asks; represent your area in planning and governance forums.
* Support clear data ownership practices, including stewardship and lineage, and contribute to hiring and onboarding when needed.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in payments, financial products or master/reference data.
* Experience taking product features from discovery through delivery, particularly in complex or fragmented environments.
* The ability to translate business, tax or compliance needs into clear, sequenced product requirements.
* Strong data fluency: you can define success measures, work with analytics or SQL, interpret data-quality signals and make evidence-based decisions.
* A practical understanding of technical systems and data flows, such as pipelines and large-scale platforms.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships across teams and business units.

Familiarity with master data management—such as golden records, data lineage, validation and governance—is useful. Experience with partner or customer data, tax or regulatory products, or B2B FinTech is a plus. You’ll also bring a thoughtful perspective on how AI may shape data, compliance and financial operations.
