job_description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel
* Other structural steel detailing / fabrication systems

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

* SolidWorks
* Autodesk Inventor
* Creo
* CATIA
* Bentley engineering products
* Other CAD/CAM/CAE, BIM, PLM, or fabrication software

  
**Additional Information**

job_description:
About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? title: Sr Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:  
The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for directing product strategy from conception and definition through implementation. This role identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans. Responsibilities include determining the market for the product, understanding marketplace requirements, and ensuring consistency of new products with the organization’s image and objectives. The Sr. Product Manager functions as a central resource, interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during the product development stage, and formulates and executes long-term plans for cost and profit control. The role also promotes the use of new technologies and industry-leading trends.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Direct product strategy from conception through implementation.
* Identify new business and market opportunities and develop business plans.
* Determine product market requirements and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
* Serve as a central resource interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during product development.
* Formulate and execute long-term plans for cost and profit control.
* Promote adoption of new technologies and industry-leading trends.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in roles such as product manager, product owner, business process analyst, or sales operations.
* Experience in applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience in developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in multi-tasking, organizing, managing, and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience in cross-functional collaboration with systems, marketing, and sales teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
* Experience in identifying, assessing, and managing tradeoffs in product development.
* Experience in identifying points of failure and formulating error-handling approaches for product resiliency.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

job_description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

Noida

Full-Time

  

**Qualifications:**

BE/BTech/MCA or any relevant degree with a background in consumer internet products

4-6 years’ experience delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them -you’re extremely proud of what you’ve accomplished.

You carry the optimum blend of business, creativity (UI/UX) and technology.

You are hands-on and go-getter to build & enhance your product through teamwork.

You are on a constant drive to expand the product through research & stitching new partnerships.

You’re expected to be a polymath who can bring ideas and analogies from different domains to solve a problem. You should be able to understand third or fourth level metrics.

Stellar design instincts and product taste

Finger-tippiness with data: you just go get the data you need with no muss/fuss and can whip it into an insightful story with no help. You know how to leverage data to make decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.

Grittiness: You never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on, you persevere when others fall away.

Own product charter & build Product Roadmap

Develop Wireframe & PRD for new features / services.

Understand Digital Technologies involved in responsive web development & API Integrations.

Hands-on experience on various product development and product management tools including but limited to Jira / Confluence / Miro / Google Analytics / Martech / CRM.

Candidates from a travel & accommodation (Market place, Property Management System and Channel Manager) background will be preferred.

Should have experience in managing B2C/B2B products - responsive web & mobile app(Android/iOS) user Interfaces.

Most importantly, you should be fun to work with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Manage Responsive Web,Mobile App, CRM, Property Management System, and all other major building blocks.

Driving Lead & Conversion Growth - Visitor to Lead & Lead to Successful Closure through UX, Research, Data driven Features and meticulous execution.

Break silos, drive wow experiences and create efficiencies through digital adoptions.

You’ll be responsible for absorbing all the complexities of the domain and making simple, elegant and polished products for our users. You’ll have to learn and unlearn fast across domains.

You’ll be working closely with the engineers, designers and analysts and marketing team who care deeply about their product. You should be able to quickly build rapport with them. Persuasiveness is more valued here than authority.

You’ll be owning product charters and would be responsible for every delivery. Your product charter will change as we evolve.

You should be able to understand macro changes in the market and identify potential opportunities and risks. You should be able to plan features in smaller sprints while keeping an eye on the larger vision.

You’ll be extremely meticulous and prudent in testing every feature that goes out. We ship high quality software.

You’ll be the internal evangelist of the product who will go to everyone and help them understand why we should build a feature.

**Soft Skills:**

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Team player who can adapt to new and evolving processes.

title: Product Manager SSC & EO
job_description:
Years of Experience: 12–15 Years

Location: Noida

Work from Office

##### **Role Purpose**

Own the assigned product portfolio from market discovery and emerging product
  
identification through specification finalisation, development, certification, launch
  
and lifecycle management. Turn market insights into differentiated products and bring
  
clear recommendations to management on product priorities, investment and
  
sourcing.

##### **Key responsibilities**

**Market research and stakeholder engagement:**

* Conduct structured market surveys, customer interviews and site visits to identify
    
  unmet needs, buying criteria and deployment challenges.
* Engage customers to understand operational needs, consultants to understand
    
  specification and compliance expectations, and Master System Integrators (MSIs)
    
  to assess integration and deployment requirements.
* Work with Sales and Presales to validate demand and consolidate feedback from
    
  active opportunities, tenders, demos and deployments.

**Emerging markets and new product identification:**

* Track emerging technologies, applications and procurement trends across Smart
    
  & Safe Cities, intelligent traffic management, video analytics and enterprise
    
  security.
* Identify new hardware, software and integrated product opportunities, including
    
  adjacent markets where Vehant can build on its existing technology, customer
    
  relationships or channel partnerships.
* Validate shortlisted opportunities with customers, consultants and MSIs.
    
  Establish the target buyer, problem to solve, willingness to pay and likely route to
    
  market.
* Build business cases covering demand, revenue potential, differentiation,
    
  technical feasibility, development and sourcing costs, certification requirements
    
  and time to market.
* Recommend whether to build, source or partner. Define measurable pilot success
    
  criteria for approved concepts.

**Competition analysis and product differentiation:**

* Benchmark competing products on functionality, field performance, integration,
    
  certifications, pricing and total cost of ownership.
* Use competitive gaps and customer feedback to define new unique selling
    
  propositions (USPs) with measurable customer benefits.
* Validate proposed USPs through comparative testing, demonstrations or field
    
  pilots and equip Sales and Presales with the evidence to communicate them.

**Product roadmap and specification finalisation:**

* Own and prioritise the hardware and software roadmap based on customer
    
  demand, commercial potential, technical feasibility and resource availability.
* Finalise product specifications with Development, Technical, IT and Quality
    
  teams. Cover performance, interfaces, interoperability, cybersecurity,
    
  environmental conditions and deployment constraints as applicable
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and secure cross-functional sign-off before
    
  development or sourcing commitments. Assess the cost, schedule and compliance
    
  impact of subsequent specification changes.

**Cross-functional execution, launch and lifecycle management:**

* Work with Sales and Presales on positioning and opportunity feedback,
    
  Development on feasibility and release delivery, Technical and Service teams on
    
  field validation and supportability, and IT on infrastructure, cybersecurity and
    
  deployment readiness.
* Coordinate prototypes, proofs of concept, field trials and release readiness
    
  reviews. Resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that affect scope, cost or
    
  timelines.
* Drive launch readiness through datasheets, compliance matrices, demonstrations,
    
  release notes and training for Sales, Presales and Service.
* Track adoption, field performance and recurring service issues. Use the findings
    
  to prioritise enhancements, upgrades and end-of-life decisions.

**Certifications, testing and compliance:**

* Identify applicable standards, certifications and tender-related compliance
    
  requirements for each product. Incorporate them into specifications, test plans
    
  and release schedules
* Coordinate testing and documentation with Development, Quality, vendors and
    
  external laboratories or certification agencies. Track gaps, corrective actions, test
    
  evidence and approvals through closure.
* Maintain a product-wise compliance matrix and track certificate validity,
    
  renewals and the impact of hardware, firmware or software changes on existing
    
  approvals.

**Vendor communication and sourcing optimisation:**

* Lead product and technical discussions with OEMs, component suppliers and
    
  technology partners. Evaluate samples, capabilities, customisation options and
    
  support commitments.
* Work with Procurement, Development and Quality to optimise bill-of-materials
    
  cost and lead times, qualify alternate sources and reduce single-source
    
  dependencies.
* Validate sourcing changes against agreed specifications, field reliability, warranty
    
  implications and certification requirements before approval.

**Monthly management review and reporting:**

* Prepare and circulate a monthly product report covering emerging product
    
  opportunities, market and competitor developments, roadmap milestones,
    
  specification sign-offs, pilots, certification status, sourcing metrics, risks and
    
  decisions required.
* Lead the monthly management review. Present options, trade-offs and a
    
  recommendation for each decision on which opportunities to pursue, defer or
    
  close, along with decisions on roadmap priorities, investment, specification
    
  changes, certification spend, vendor selection and launch readiness.
* Record decisions, action owners and due dates. Track actions to closure and
    
  escalate blockers that require attention before the next review.

##### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in B2B technology, with demonstrated ownership of
    
  hardware and software products or integrated solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. An MBA is
    
  desirable.
* Experience in intelligent traffic systems, smart or safe cities, surveillance, AI
    
  video analytics, industrial IoT or embedded systems is preferred.

##### **Core Capabilities**

* Proven ability to identify and validate new market opportunities and take
    
  products from specification through pilot, certification, launch and post-launch
    
  review.
* Experience engaging customers, consultants and system integrators and
    
  translating their inputs into product and commercial decisions.
* Working knowledge of vendor qualification, product costing, alternate sourcing
    
  and compliance documentation.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and present concise, evidence-based
    
  recommendations to senior management.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

 **Job Description**

**About the Role:**

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.

You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

**Responsibilities:**

* Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
* Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
* Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

**Additional (Preferred):**

* OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

 **Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Senior Product Manager - Life Insurance & Annuity
job_description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

The Senior Product Manager leads the Product Life Cycle and strongly contributes to the research & development activities related to the design and development of our products and qualification or re-qualification of new and existing products. The individual will work with Zinnia's Product Organization to ensure alignment with organization's strategy and vision.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead & contribute into the execution of product lifecycle processes for our Insurtech products/platforms, work with cross-functional teams to ensure fulfilment of product requirements, evaluates product performance and transition products from development to commercialization.
* Lead technical discussions with Engineering teams & thoroughly manage technical/business requirements.
* Assists in determining product delivery and deployment dates for new product releases, feature and maintenance releases and regular corrective service or service pack releases.
* Mentor a lean team of Product Managers while acting as a technical consultant to the product organization and leads research and prototyping of innovative technologies and products.
* Ensures the technology and architectural roadmap of engineering is properly aligned with and supports the product/business road map
* Acts as a customer liaison on technical issues related to product integration, custom development and requirements.
* May lead major releases and ensure feature enhancements respond to customer requests.
* Responsible for product delivery managing schedules and tasks related to all aspects of product development.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* **9+ years of experience into Product Management, including analyzing software/product design, development, and deployment.**
* **Domain expertise in US Life Insurance & Annuity.**
* Bachelor's/Master's or equivalent Degree in technology or related field
* **Strong Background of working as a Technical & Functional Product Manager or Business Analyst/Product Analyst in an enterprise environment.**
* **Hands-on understanding of API Integration, SQL, Data Analysis etc.**
* **Strong understanding of SDLC & technology system interfaces, data integration.**
* An SME who performs work with a high degree of latitude; handles the most complex issues.
* Possess strong Communication skills, Problem-solving & Analytical thinking skills.
* Can lead individual assignments & deliver with strong expertise
* Expert level experience in delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and the use of relevant tools
* Ability to influence, lead, and work as part of a cross-functional in a global team setup

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**

Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, profit sharing, PF, incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We're looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

job_description:
Company: Curavea Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Department: Product Management

Designation: Product Manager

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager for our pharmaceutical business. The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing product strategies, managing product portfolios, supporting sales and marketing activities, and driving brand growth in the market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Brand Management

* Manage the company's pharmaceutical product portfolio.
* Develop brand strategies to increase product sales and market share.
* Plan and execute new product launches.
* Identify opportunities for existing product growth.

2. Market Research & Analysis

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Monitor competitor brands, pricing, products and promotional activities.
* Identify market trends and new business opportunities.
* Analyse product performance and sales reports.

3. Sales & Marketing Support

* Develop marketing strategies and promotional plans for pharmaceutical products.
* Prepare visual aids, product presentations, product literature and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with RSMs, DSMs and the sales team to improve product performance.
* Provide product knowledge and scientific training to the sales team.
* Develop strategies for doctor engagement and prescription generation.

4. New Product Development

* Identify potential molecules and therapeutic segments for new product launches.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams for product development and launch planning.
* Study product positioning, pricing and market potential.

5. Coordination & Reporting

* Work closely with the sales, marketing and management teams.
* Track monthly product-wise sales and brand performance.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve sales and brand visibility.

Required Qualifications

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Life Sciences).
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and product management.

Experience

* 3–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in pharmaceutical product management or brand management preferred.
* Experience in handling product portfolios, marketing strategies and sales team coordination.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Market research and analytical skills.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical products and therapeutic segments.
* Strategic thinking and planning.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Product-wise sales growth.
* New product launch performance.
* Market share and brand growth.
* Promotional strategy effectiveness.
* Sales team product knowledge and training.
* Achievement of product-wise business targets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role and Team:**

A hybrid Product Manager role embedded within the Data Science team. You'll own the product direction for ML-driven capabilities — bidding algorithms, traffic quality (fraud detection), and audience modeling — while maintaining the operational rigor required for MRC/TAG compliance. You'll be part of the broader PM community, following established practices and gradually expanding your scope.

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**

**Product Management**

* Own and prioritize the Data Science team backlog; define user stories and acceptance criteria
* Lead scopes where domain knowledge is primarily algorithm/ML-driven; support cross team scopes as a secondary PM
* Participate in roadmap planning, sprint planning, and PM syncs, and uphold established PM ways of working — from templates and documentation standards to consistent communication and proactive
* stakeholder management
* Bridge Product leadership and Data Scientists — translate business needs into technical priorities and vice versa
    
    
  **Algorithm Analysis & Validation**
* Analyze and validate ML algorithm outputs (bidding, delivery predictions, audience models) against business KPIs
* Test model outputs, identify when and why algorithms underperform, and provide actionable feedback to data scientists
* Conduct advanced investigation and analysis for algorithm-related performance issues
* Support A/B test design and analysis for algorithm changes
    
    
  **Ad & Traffic Quality (Fraud) Operations**
* Investigate fraud-related issues — IP/domain/app unblocking, ads.txt issues, discrepancy reports, DOOH/CTV/Retail Media whitelisting
* Manage fraud blacklists (IP, domain, UA, app) using internal tools
* Run compliance cycles — Backward Looking Assessments, quarterly risk assessments, IVT filter reviews,
* TAG/IWL list updates, methodology disclosures — and look for opportunities to AI automate the recurring,
* Repeatable parts rather than only running them manually
* Support TAG/MRC audits and contribute to RFI/RFP responses on traffic quality
    
    
  **Industry & AI Awareness**
* Track AdTech trends, AI/ML developments, and competitive landscape to inform priorities

**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**

* 3–5 years in a product, analytics, or technical role working alongside data science/ML teams
* 1–2 years of experience in AdTech or programmatic advertising
* Hands-on experience testing or analyzing ML model outputs (not building them)
* Strong analytical skills — SQL, data analysis tools, basic statistics
* Solid product fundamentals — backlog management, stakeholder alignment, acceptance criteria
* Excellent communication — can explain algorithm behavior to non-technical stakeholders

**Stand out by having:**

* Comfort working in an AI-native way — using LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate analysis, drafting, and
* Investigation, and a sense for where recurring workflows can be automated rather than just executed
* Familiarity with ad fraud / IVT concepts and MRC/TAG standards
* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
* Python/R for data exploration

**Our promise to you:**

* A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues

* Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family

* 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

* Paid maternity (6 months) and paternity (2 weeks)

* Annual learning budget to help you grow your skills and support continuous learning

* Rewarding referral program for helping us grow

* Global perks such as birthday gifts, work anniversaries, and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun

* And much more – join us to explore the full experience

**Diversity & Inclusion @Adform:**

Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager-Components
job_description:
Job Description

Position: Product Manager-Components

Reporting: Global Technical Lead

Job Location: Mumbai

Grade Level: Management

Purpose:

Product Manager Components will be responsible for managing and developing lubricant additive components. The

role involves technical evaluation, product development, performance testing, troubleshooting and providing technical

support to customers, suppliers and internal business teams.

The position requires strong technical knowledge of lubricant additives chemistries, base oils, finished lubricants,

testing methodologies and industry standards, along with the ability to coordinate technical projects and ensure

successful product qualification.

Responsibilities:

Technical Product Development & Management

 Manage and develop lubricant additive components and formulations for various applications.

 Evaluate raw materials, base oils, additive packages and their compatibility.

 Identify opportunities for new product development and improvement of existing formulations.

 Conduct technical assessments of product performance and suitability for different applications.

 Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers for technical specifications and product improvements.

 Coordinate with external laboratories for product testing and evaluation.

 Review and interpret laboratory test reports and technical data.

 Ensure testing is conducted as per applicable ASTM, ISO and other international standards.

 Evaluate test results and recommend necessary formulation improvements.

 Monitor product quality, consistency and performance against specifications.

Customer Technical Support

 Provide technical assistance and solutions to customers as per lubricant application.

 Handle technical queries, product complaints and troubleshooting requirements.

 Conduct technical discussions and presentations with customers.

 Support customer product trials, field evaluations and product qualification.

 Coordinate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide appropriate technical

solutions.

Supplier & Vendor Coordination

 Coordinate with global additive manufacturers, component suppliers and technical partners.

 Obtain and evaluate technical data sheets (TDS), safety data sheets (SDS), certificates of analysis (COA) and

product specifications.

 Review new products and assess their technical suitability.

 Maintain technical communication with international suppliers and partners.

Technical Documentation & Compliance

 Prepare and maintain technical reports, product specifications and evaluation reports.

 Maintain product development records and technical documentation.

 Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and customer requirements.

 Support product qualification, technical audits and customer assessments.

 Maintain updated technical databases for products, components and formulations.

Team & Project Coordination

 Coordinate with internal technical, sales, operations and laboratory teams.

 Monitor technical projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines.

 Provide technical guidance and support to team members.

 Participate in customer meetings, technical conferences, exhibitions and industry events.

 Submit regular technical progress reports to management.

Qualifications & Experience required:

Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Technology, Lubricant

Technology or a related discipline. Additional qualifications or certifications in lubricant technology and additive

chemistry will be an advantage.

Level of experience: 8–12 years of relevant experience in the lubricant additives, lubricants, petroleum or specialty

chemicals industry.

Technical skills: Strong understanding of lubricant additive chemistry, base oils and finished lubricant formulations.

Product development, technical evaluation and performance testing. Understanding of engine oils, industrial lubricants,

greases and specialty lubricants. Knowledge of ASTM, API, ACEA and relevant international specifications. Knowledge of

tribology testing, good analytical skills. Technical writing, Proven customer focus.

Behavioural competencies: Excellent communication and technical presentation skills, good interpersonal skills, team

spirit, open mindedness, sense of creativity.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

 Successful completion of technical development and product qualification projects.

 Timely resolution of customer technical queries and complaints.

 Accuracy and quality of technical evaluations and reports.

 Successful coordination of laboratory testing and product validation.

 Development and improvement of lubricant additive components and formulations.

 Technical support provided to sales and business development teams.

 Effective supplier and customer technical coordination.

 Achievement of project milestones within agreed timelines.

Stakeholders

Internal: Global Technical Head / Director – Technical & Technology, Technical Team, Sales & Business Development

Team, Operations & Administration Team

External: Suppliers, customers, OEM, third party labs, Universities, consultants and industry partners

General Expectations

 Maintain confidentiality of company information, formulations and technical data.

 Demonstrate professional conduct in all internal and external communications.

 Take ownership of assigned technical responsibilities and projects.

 Maintain a customer-focused and solution-oriented approach.

 Be willing to travel domestically and internationally as per business requirements.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Turn Pricing Into Perfect Matches

  

At Shaadi.com, we don’t just help people find love—we build products that make millions of journeys possible. We’re looking for a sharp, high-energy Product Manager to own our Pricing & Promotions pods, where every experiment, offer, and price point directly shapes growth, conversion, and revenue.
  
If you love decoding user behaviour, running high-impact experiments, and turning data into business wins, this role is your kind of match.

️What You’ll Own

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for pricing, promotions, offers, and monetisation initiatives across Shaadi.com.
* Design and launch pricing models, discounting strategies, subscription offers, and campaign-led promotions that drive conversions without compromising long-term value.
* Use analytics, A/B tests, and user research to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure impact on revenue, retention, and user experience.
* Partner closely with Tech, Design, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Business teams to ship initiatives end to end.
* Monitor key metrics—conversion, ARPU, revenue, uptake, churn, and margin—and translate insights into clear product decisions.
* Balance user delight with business outcomes: build offers that feel valuable to members while driving sustainable growth.

  

Who We’re Looking For

* 2–4 years of product management experience, ideally in pricing, promotions, growth, monetisation, or B2C product roles.
* Experience at a top consumer-facing organisation is strongly preferred—someone who understands scale, speed, and user-first thinking.
* MBA from a top B-school is preferred.
* High IQ, strong structured thinking, and the ability to simplify complex trade-offs quickly.
* Comfortable with data: funnels, cohorts, experiments, pricing elasticity, and business metrics.
* A builder’s mindset: proactive, ownership-driven, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to ship fast.

Why Shaadi.com?

* Work on one of India’s most iconic consumer internet brands, with real impact on millions of users.
* Own high-visibility pricing and promotions pods where your decisions move the business.
* Be based in Mumbai, working onsite with product, tech, and business leaders.

title: Data Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**

Together with analytics team leaders you will support our business with excellent data models to uncover trends that can drive long-term business results.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Work in close partnership with the business leadership team to execute the analytics agenda
* Identify and incubate best-in-class external partners to drive delivery on strategic projects
* Develop custom models/algorithms to uncover signals/patterns and trends to drive long-term business performance
* Execute the business analytics program agenda using a methodical approach that conveys to stakeholders what business analytics will deliver

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Using data analysis to make recommendations to senior leaders
* Technical experience in roles in best-in-class analytics practices
* Experience deploying new analytical approaches in a complex and highly matrixed organization
* Savvy in usage of the analytics techniques to create business impacts

**IN THIS ROLE** — Lead end-to-end lifecycle ownership of one or more Data Products on Mondelēz's DBx-based enterprise data platform. Accountable for requirements, roadmap, design governance, delivery quality, operational oversight, and retirement execution. Combines strategic product ownership with hands-on analytical execution.

**WHAT THIS TEAM AND ROLE DOES** — Part of the MDS Data Products team driving AI-native transformation. Global data product strategy, delivery, and governance across the full lifecycle (demand intake discovery design build test deploy operate retire). Works at the intersection of business strategy, data governance, and technical delivery.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** — Experience bridging business and technical teams in data product delivery; passion for data governance and quality; strong stakeholder management across various stakeholders.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**:

* Own and maintain the data product roadmap.
* Facilitate data contracts with stakeholders.
* Engage with cross functional teams on demand prioritization and enterprise-level decisions.
* Lead requirements gathering, functional analysis, fit-gap assessments and scoping.
* Oversee design fitment, source discovery, and Source-to-Target Mapping (STTM).
* Approve initial designs, HLD, DIF documentation.
* Execute STTM mapping and document gap findings.
* Approve DQ validation, KPI acceptance, and release documentation.
* Prepare test cases, execute test scripts, and produce test evidence documentation.
* Coordinate UAT logistics - liaise with business stakeholders and document outcomes.
* Own UAT sign-off and Data Product assessments.
* Drive and own the Data Product Certification process.
* Prepare certification artefacts and supporting documentation.
* Own data product release and CAB documentation.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field.
* 5+ years in data product management, data analytics, or data engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of data lifecycle management (ingestion through retirement).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (GCP/BigQuery preferred).
* Hands-on experience with STTM mapping, DQ validation, and data quality frameworks.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, metadata management, and data contracts.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**GOOD TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Experience with DBT, Airflow/Composer, or similar data pipeline tools.
* Knowledge of FAIR data principles and data certification frameworks
* Background in FMCG/CPG industry data environments.
* Familiarity with data catalog tools (Collibra, Alation, Dataplex).
* Understanding of canonical data modeling and enterprise data standards.
* Experience with Jira and ADO.

No Relocation support available

**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------

### **At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.**

### **We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as** ***Oreo*****,** ***belVita*** **and** ***LU*** **biscuits;** ***Cadbury Dairy Milk*****,** ***Milka*** **and** ***Toblerone*** **chocolate;** ***Sour Patch Kids*** **candy and** ***Trident*** **gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.**

### **Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more** **than 80 countries** **and we sell our products in** **over 150 countries** **around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.**

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Job Type**
------------

RegularAnalytics & ModellingAnalytics & Data Science

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Global Payment Services (GPS), GPS INM Product team as Product Manager – Receivables.

**Job Introduction**

Manage the GPS INM receivables portfolio, encompassing UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect and structured B2B reconciliation products, including DART, ARR and third-party offerings. The role covers the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept, development and enhancement to launch, maintenance and commercialisation. Working under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager, coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver seamless client onboarding, effective collection and reconciliation solutions, robust supporting processes, sound product governance and a consistent client experience.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage the development, enhancement, launch, maintenance and ongoing performance of UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect, DART, ARR and other structured B2B and third-party reconciliation offerings.
* Translate client needs and business requirements into defined product designs, prioritised enhancements and actionable launch plans. Use market insights, competitor benchmarking and client feedback from Sales, Coverage and GPS teams to develop differentiated propositions, maintain a prioritised backlog and incorporate client validation and pilot feedback.
* Evaluate partnerships with acquiring providers, payment platforms and reconciliation solution providers. Coordinate IT, Operations, Client Management, GPS teams and external partners to deliver integrated client collection and reconciliation propositions, with clear ownership, agreed actions and appropriate partner due diligence and governance.
* Define and maintain end-to-end operating and service models covering client onboarding, production service continuity, collections, reconciliation, exception handling and ongoing servicing. Work with Operations and Client Management to document and agree workflows and resolve exceptions within agreed service timelines.
* Coordinate product deployments, enhancements, testing and launch readiness, with documented requirements and stakeholder approvals. Deliver assigned initiatives against agreed milestones and provide concise updates on priorities, progress, risks and decisions, escalating delivery dependencies promptly to the Senior Product Manager.
* Support commercialisation and client adoption through product collateral, sales enablement and ongoing enhancements. Partner with GPS and Coverage teams to convert client opportunities into suitable receivables solutions, tracking progress against agreed plans, product adoption and client usage.
* Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory guidelines and HSBC policies, internal controls and the Group Compliance Policy. Identify product, third-party and operational risks with risk stewards, coordinate controls and approvals, track mitigating actions and report losses appropriately. Support third-party assessments, regulatory reporting and client-issue resolution; monitor relevant collection, reconciliation and applicable partner chargeback/refund metrics; submit credit-risk exceptions and pricing decisions for approval; and ensure timely implementation of audit actions and resolution of regulator-raised issues.

**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, or equivalent, with a university degree and/or relevant training qualifications.
* Demonstrated progressive experience and a proven track record in cash management, receivables and/or payments product development and management, or equivalent relevant experience, including product development, project management, fintech engagement and market- or client-facing banking functions.
* Corporate transaction banking or cash management experience is preferred, but not mandatory. Experience in merchant acquiring, UPI collections, NACH, Virtual Accounts or structured B2B reconciliation is preferred, but not mandatory; familiarity with DART, ARR or third-party reconciliation offerings is beneficial.
* Demonstrated project and programme management experience, including co-creating solutions with IT and internal business partners. Excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and deliver within tight deadlines.
* Ability to develop innovative, flexible solutions addressing client needs and to understand clients’ business models, operating needs and core business fundamentals. Sound business acumen and commercial awareness, including relevant economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory considerations.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective internal and external relationships. A collaborative approach to teamwork, supported by self-motivation and a proactive working style.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to develop well-founded recommendations for decision-making. Familiarity with emerging technologies is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear, compelling presentations. Fluency in English is expected; additional language skills are beneficial.

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**

**Additional Notes:**

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.
