author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Who We Are**

Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning — to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually — turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us.

**The Team You’ll Join**

This role sits within the Provenir Product team, a horizontal global team responsible for the success of the Provenir offering. The team covers three functions:

* **Product Management:** management of the product life cycle, working closely with technology teams.
* **Product Design:** developing compelling, market- and product-driven content and information for the wider business.
* **AI / Innovation:** working with the wider business to ensure products and solutions are sold and delivered effectively.

As a Senior Product Manager you will sit in Product Management and work in tight collaboration with Technology, Sales, Finance, Marketing and Delivery to optimise our end-to-end operation and our growth.

**What You’ll Do**

Reporting to the VP of Product Management, you will own the day-to-day product management for our Case Management module and also support our Decisioning and Decision Intelligence capabilities, managing product value from concept through launch and into growth.

You will turn customer and market insight into a clear roadmap and a high-value commercial proposition, and equip Sales, Pre-sales and Customer Success to win and retain customers with it. You will work closely with engineering and engage directly with customers as a Product Management representative within our Global Product team.

This is a remote role, with occasional travel to the regional offices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap and product requirements for your module/s, from ideation to launch, aligned with the wider Provenir roadmap.
* Define how Case Management fits into customers' operational workflows (for example manual review and investigation) and how it connects to Decisioning.
* Work with engineering and design to define functional and technical requirements, write clear user stories, prioritise the backlog and accept delivered work.
* Conduct market research and analyse customer needs and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and product requirements.
* Develop a clear, compelling product proposition that resonates with target audiences, differentiates our offering and leads to commercial success.
* Enable Sales and Customer Success to communicate the value of your modules effectively, with materials, training and live support on customer conversations.
* Partner with Pre-sales so they can explain and demonstrate the value of the product with confidence.
* Engage directly with customers and prospects through discovery, feedback loops and design partnerships.
* Track and measure the success of your modules, and contribute to GTM strategies that grow associated revenues.
* Build close working relationships across the business and communicate plans, timelines and trade-offs clearly and often.

**Qualifications, Strengths and Skills**

**Required**

* Proven and extensive track record of experience in Product Management, including owning a product or module from concept to launch
* Current experience of working in B2B SaaS companies
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Strong technical background and understanding of software development processes
* Ability to analyse data, identify trends and make data-driven decisions
* Experience collaborating with both external and internal stakeholders across time zones
* Ability to build relationships and manage multiple stakeholders, with excellent written and verbal communication

**Good to have**

* Credit risk or fraud industry knowledge
* Experience with case management, decisioning, workflow or AI-enabled products.

Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave.

*At Provenir, we recognize that diversity and inclusion make our teams stronger. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, citizenship, or veteran status or medical condition. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.*

title: Senior Product Manager - Life Insurance & Annuity
job_description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

The Senior Product Manager leads the Product Life Cycle and strongly contributes to the research & development activities related to the design and development of our products and qualification or re-qualification of new and existing products. The individual will work with Zinnia's Product Organization to ensure alignment with organization's strategy and vision.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead & contribute into the execution of product lifecycle processes for our Insurtech products/platforms, work with cross-functional teams to ensure fulfilment of product requirements, evaluates product performance and transition products from development to commercialization.
* Lead technical discussions with Engineering teams & thoroughly manage technical/business requirements.
* Assists in determining product delivery and deployment dates for new product releases, feature and maintenance releases and regular corrective service or service pack releases.
* Mentor a lean team of Product Managers while acting as a technical consultant to the product organization and leads research and prototyping of innovative technologies and products.
* Ensures the technology and architectural roadmap of engineering is properly aligned with and supports the product/business road map
* Acts as a customer liaison on technical issues related to product integration, custom development and requirements.
* May lead major releases and ensure feature enhancements respond to customer requests.
* Responsible for product delivery managing schedules and tasks related to all aspects of product development.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* **9+ years of experience into Product Management, including analyzing software/product design, development, and deployment.**
* **Domain expertise in US Life Insurance & Annuity.**

**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**

Take Ownership: Own and build modules for sustained differentiation and growth. Develop deep domain expertise and understand trends in the market. The role requires you to plan, build, release, and measure success for an end to end modules.

Be a Customer Champion: Develop a sense of empathy with our customer base to build an understanding of various problems. The role is also a bridge between the customer and the engineering teams to ensure focus on solving customer needs & delivering continuous value. Practice Craftsmanship: Learn and Practice product craft. Create solutions with delightful user experiences and find the balance between solving the customer problem and shipping the right product solution. We take pride in releasing the smallest of features while iterating and shipping regularly.

Play as One Team: The role needs you to communicate clearly to various stakeholders of Product development, Engineering, Marketing, Sales & Leadership teams and work together to bring your vision to life.

Act with Urgency: Breakdown complex problems to phases to help the team make incremental progress while still keeping the bigger picture intact. You’d evangelize the vision and ensure maximum customer value is achieved with the appropriate amount of work.

 **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of working in global/cross-functional software teams in a software product company. SaaS experience is preferred as you’d settle right in.
* Experience in building SaaS products is a plus
* Being empathetic and having a strong listening ability to understand the other person - may it be a customer or a stakeholder.
* Ability to arrive at intuitive & uncomplicated solutions from concept to scale by leveraging AI.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts/customer problems in a simple way to internal & external stakeholders.
* A track record of making day-to-day data-driven decisions in a fast-evolving environment while keeping an eye on the overall vision.
* Having worked in a mode of structured experimentation - measuring and iterating on problems from time to time to achieve product goals.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Senior Product Manager - Mutual Funds
job_description:
Designation: NA

Location: India Maharashtra Thane - GCorp

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and investment products with a strong focus on Mutual Funds. The role will drive product strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, integrations and business outcomes across mobile and web platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in a digital investment platform, wealth-tech company, fintech, bank or broking environment, and a strong understanding of the mutual fund investment lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Mutual Fund Product Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end mutual fund product lifecycle across discovery, investment, servicing and portfolio management.
* Drive digital journeys for onboarding, KYC, risk profiling, lumpsum investments, SIP registration, mandate setup, purchase, redemption, switch, cancellation, SIP pause/modify and transaction tracking.
* Build and enhance fund discovery, scheme details, comparison, filters, portfolio views, performance analytics, goal-based investing and investor education features.
* Work on integrations with AMCs, RTAs, BSE StAR MF / relevant transaction platforms, payment gateways, banks and other ecosystem partners, as applicable.
* Improve funnel conversion, transaction success, SIP activation, repeat investments, AUM growth and customer retention.
* Ensure a seamless experience across direct and regular mutual fund propositions, where applicable.

**2. Digital Product Strategy & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and success metrics in line with business objectives and customer needs.
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, product requirement documents, user stories, use cases, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Drive product discovery through customer insights, data analysis, market research and competitor benchmarking.
* Partner with UX/UI, engineering, QA, operations, compliance and business teams to deliver scalable and intuitive digital experiences.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, UAT, release management and post-launch monitoring.

**3. Wealth & Investment Products**
-----------------------------------

* Work across adjacent investment products such as equities, ETFs, fixed deposits, bonds, NCDs, NPS, digital gold, PMS and AIFs, based on business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to create integrated investment journeys, cross-sell relevant products and improve customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with AMCs, banks, brokers, fintech partners and vendors for product launches and platform integrations.

**4. Analytics & Business Growth**
----------------------------------

* Define and track KPIs including visitor-to-investor conversion, KYC completion, SIP registrations, mandate success, order success, AUM, active investors and repeat transaction rates.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel drop-offs, cohorts and product usage to identify growth and experience improvements.
* Use experimentation, A/B testing and data-led prioritisation to optimise product journeys.
* Prepare product performance dashboards and business reviews for senior stakeholders.

**5. Regulatory, Risk & Compliance**
------------------------------------

* Work with compliance, legal and operations teams to translate applicable SEBI, AMFI, AMCs, RTA and other regulatory requirements into product features and controls.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures, risk profiling, suitability, consent, audit trails and transaction controls are incorporated into customer journeys.
* Support regulatory change implementation, issue resolution and applicable reporting requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 10–14 years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on product management experience in mutual funds or digital investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of the mutual fund lifecycle, including onboarding/KYC, fund discovery, purchase, SIP, mandates, redemption, switch, portfolio tracking and servicing.
* Experience owning digital products on mobile apps and/or web platforms, preferably in a high-volume consumer fintech or wealth-tech environment.
* Ability to define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritise roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, business teams and external technology partners.
* Strong product analytics, funnel analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Working knowledge of APIs, payment flows, integrations, Agile delivery and UAT.

**Preferred Company Background**
================================

Candidates from digital investment, wealth-tech, fintech, discount broking and online mutual fund platforms will be strongly preferred. Relevant target organisations may include:

* Groww
* Zerodha (especially Coin / mutual fund product teams)
* ET Money
* INDmoney
* Kuvera
* Paytm Money
* Upstox
* Angel One
* FundsIndia
* Scripbox
* Other comparable digital wealth or mutual fund investment platforms.

Important: Prior experience in one of the above companies is a sourcing preference, not a substitute for relevant product ownership. Candidates must have directly worked on mutual fund product features, journeys or platform enhancements. Experience limited to sales, relationship management, distribution or back-office operations without digital product ownership would not be sufficient for this role.

**Educational Qualifications**
==============================

* MBA / PGDM / MFM or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
* NISM or other relevant capital markets / mutual fund certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================

* Growth in mutual fund investors, AUM and SIP registrations.
* Improvement in onboarding, KYC, mandate and transaction conversion rates.
* Order success rate, journey completion and reduction in customer drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, active usage, repeat investments and customer retention.
* On-time delivery of roadmap commitments and quality of product releases.
* Regulatory readiness and timely implementation of compliance requirements.

title: Senior Product Manager – Private Markets, Data & Feeds
job_description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Product Manager to lead the growth and execution of our **Private Markets Data & Feeds proposition** . This role will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, commercial roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives for private markets datasets across asset classes including Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Infrastructure, and Real Assets.

The successful candidate will act as the intersection between clients, sales, content, technology, and strategic partners to deliver data products that meet the evolving needs of institutional investors, quantitative researchers, asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and alternative investment firms.

This is a highly visible role with responsibility for driving revenue growth, client adoption, product innovation, and market positioning within a rapidly expanding private markets ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Commercial Leadership**

* Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Private Markets Data & Feeds business.
* Develop product vision, roadmap, and business cases aligned with client demand and market trends.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.
* Establish pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies to maximize market penetration and profitability.
* Own product P&L, growth targets, and business performance metrics.

### **Client & Market Engagement**

* Engage directly with Investment Banking, buy-side, sell-side, wealth, and research clients to understand current and emerging use cases.
* Translate client requirements into scalable product capabilities and data solutions.
* Represent the business externally at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and strategic forums.
* Gather competitive intelligence and monitor developments across private markets, alternative investments, and data providers.

### **Product Development & Execution**

* Partner closely with data Strategy, engineering, data operations, and delivery teams to prioritize product enhancements.
* Define requirements for data models, coverage expansion, feed structures, APIs, cloud delivery, and integration capabilities.
* Drive agile product development processes and ensure successful product launches.
* Monitor client feedback and usage analytics to identify product improvement opportunities.

### **Commercial & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Enable Sales and Customer Success teams through value propositions, positioning, competitive messaging, and sales collateral.
* Support major commercial opportunities, RFPs, strategic negotiations, and client onboarding activities.
* Develop market segmentation strategies and targeted growth plans for key client segments.
* Establish KPIs and monitor adoption, retention, revenue growth, and client satisfaction.

### **Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop strategic relationships with private market participants, data providers, technology platforms, and ecosystem partners.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy opportunities and support acquisition, partnership, and investment initiatives.
Drive integration and commercialization of third-party datasets where appropriate.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Science, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Commercial Product Strategy, Market Data, Financial Information Services, or Alternative Investments.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets, including:
  + - M&A
  + - Equity New Issues
  + - Debt New issues
  + - Loans
  + - Repurchases
  + - Joint Venture
  + - Shareholder Activism
  + - Poinson Pill
  + - Municipals
  + - Sustainable Finance
  + - Private Equity
  + - Private Credit
  + - Real Assets
  + - Fund performance & Benchmarking
* Experience managing enterprise data products, data feeds, APIs, or cloud-based data distribution platforms.
* Demonstrated success driving product growth and commercial outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple teams and senior leadership levels.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and client-facing skills.

* Experience within financial data providers, exchanges, investment research firms, alternative data vendors, or private markets technology platforms.
* Deep knowledge of institutional investor workflows and investment research processes.
* Familiarity with cloud data delivery platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of quantitative investment workflows and data integration requirements.

**Career Stage:**

Manager  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

  
  

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. ----------------

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Product Manager to lead the growth and execution of our **Private Markets Data & Feeds proposition** . This role will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, commercial roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives for private markets datasets across asset classes including Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Infrastructure, and Real Assets.

The successful candidate will act as the intersection between clients, sales, content, technology, and strategic partners to deliver data products that meet the evolving needs of institutional investors, quantitative researchers, asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and alternative investment firms.

This is a highly visible role with responsibility for driving revenue growth, client adoption, product innovation, and market positioning within a rapidly expanding private markets ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Commercial Leadership**

* Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Private Markets Data & Feeds business.
* Develop product vision, roadmap, and business cases aligned with client demand and market trends.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.
* Establish pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies to maximize market penetration and profitability.
* Own product P&L, growth targets, and business performance metrics.

### **Client & Market Engagement**

* Engage directly with Investment Banking, buy-side, sell-side, wealth, and research clients to understand current and emerging use cases.
* Translate client requirements into scalable product capabilities and data solutions.
* Represent the business externally at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and strategic forums.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**  
  
**As part of the Sabre Payments team, this Senior Product Manager will lead the definition, execution, and delivery of strategic payment initiatives critical to scaling Sabre’s global business. Operating at the core intersection of travel and modern financial technology, the role bridges commercial strategy and technical engineering to build robust, scalable payment capabilities. The successful candidate will resolve complex product challenges creatively to deliver high-impact solutions for our project teams, broader department, and travel partners. In doing so, this position directly advances Sabre’s overarching strategic vision of powering next-generation travel retailing and seamless transaction workflows worldwide.**

  

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**

* **Product Strategy & Requirement Translation:** Serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, translating high-level business goals into actionable functional specifications, technical requirements, and detailed user stories.
* **End-to-End Delivery & Execution:** Own and drive the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle across cross-functional engineering and design teams, ensuring features are delivered on schedule and directly impact the success of the project team, department, and clients.
* **Creative Problem-Solving & Technical Alignment:** Resolve a wide range of complex product and integration challenges through creative, scalable technical solutions, maintaining high quality and operational reliability.
* **Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Networking:** Proactively network and collaborate with senior internal teams (engineering, architecture, commercial) and external partners/vendors within your domain of expertise to align priorities and clear project roadmaps.
* **Team Guidance & Best Practices:** Act as a fully qualified domain practitioner, mentoring junior product associates or team members on product management best practices, backlog grooming, and Agile methodologies where applicable.

  

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**

* **Relevant Experience:** 5 years of dedicated product management experience partnering directly with engineering teams to define, build, and deliver customer-facing or platform products and capabilities.
* **Technical & Analytical Acumen:** Strong experience decomposing complex workflows into clear user stories, API/technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and roadmap milestones within Agile/Scrum environments.
* **Proven Delivery & Creative Problem Solving:** Demonstrated track record of independently resolving multifaceted product challenges in creative ways to drive measurable project and business outcomes.
* **Stakeholder & Influence Skills:** Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to network, build alignment, and present effectively across both senior technical leadership and commercial stakeholders.
* **Domain Knowledge (Preferred):** Prior domain experience in digital payments, fintech gateways/processing, or the travel technology ecosystem is a strong plus

  

**4. Why Join Us**

* **Lead at the Intersection of Travel & Fintech:** Directly contribute to architecting and scaling a high-growth travel fintech ecosystem that processes transactions across the global travel marketplace.
* **Innovation & Cutting-Edge Tech:** Join Sabre at the forefront of AI-driven transformation, leveraging modern platforms and intelligent automation to reshape how the world travels and transacts.
* **Autonomous Impact & Visibility:** Step into a "fully qualified" L10 role with meaningful ownership over strategic initiatives, where your solutions have a direct line of sight to client success and departmental growth.
* **Collaborative Culture & Growth:** Work within a collaborative, globally distributed team that champions knowledge sharing, continuous mentorship, and clear pathways for senior product leadership advancement.

  

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Turn concepts into delivery-ready work
  + Partner with product, clinical, operational, and engineering stakeholders to understand business problems, functional needs, users, workflows, and intended outcomes
  + Translate concepts into clear features, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, and success measures
  + Seek clarity when needs are incomplete or conflicting rather than allowing assumptions to become requirements
  + Produce high-quality, usable features in partnership with engineering teams and refine them until they are ready for execution
* Create execution visibility and control
  + Maintain a clear view of each major deliverable, its owner, current status, progress, dependencies, barriers, and required decisions
  + Plan and facilitate meetings with a clear purpose and agenda; document decisions, owners, and next actions
  + Proactively communicate status, scope changes, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts
  + Escalate risks early enough for stakeholders to resolve barriers or make informed tradeoffs before commitments shift
* Lead cross-functional collaboration
  + Build rapport and trusted working relationships with clinical experts, operations stakeholders, product partners, and engineering teams
  + Listen carefully, ask thoughtful follow-up questions, and ensure expert knowledge is understood, documented, retained, and applied to future work
  + Influence without direct authority and help stakeholders reach clarity on priorities, requirements, tradeoffs, and ownership
  + Coordinate initiatives that cross sprint boundaries or require alignment across multiple teams
* Advance healthcare workflow modernization
  + Develop an increasingly solid understanding of healthcare workflows, systems, data considerations, and operational constraints
  + Explore not only what needs to be built, but why it matters and how the workflow could be improved
  + Identify opportunities to apply technology, automation, interoperability, and AI to improve healthcare processes and outcomes
  + Keep healthcare privacy, data protection, regulatory, and governance considerations visible throughout product discovery and delivery
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, technology consulting, solution design, software delivery, or related disciplines supporting software-enabled products
* 3+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and managing business requirements, user stories, workflows, process maps, acceptance criteria, and delivery-ready product artifacts
* 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving business, operational, and technical stakeholders
* 3+ years of experience working within Agile software development environments such as Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or similar frameworks
* Demonstrated experience translating complex or ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements and product deliverables
* Demonstrated experience facilitating stakeholder discussions, driving alignment, documenting decisions, and managing competing priorities
* Proven experience identifying, communicating, and escalating risks, dependencies, scope changes, and delivery challenges
* Working knowledge of software development processes and technology concepts sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and ask informed technical questions
* Proven exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and meeting facilitation skills
* Demonstrated ability to organize multiple concurrent initiatives, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder groups
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and build trusted relationships across product, operations, and technology teams
* Demonstrated learning agility and ability to quickly understand and retain knowledge about complex business domains

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Chennai, TN

**About The Role:**

Condé Nast is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Trusted Data Products to help transform how data powers insights, innovation, and decision-making across our global portfolio of brands. As AI reshapes how businesses interact with data, we are evolving our data platform to make trusted information more accessible, actionable, and intelligent. This role will help build the foundations that allow teams to move beyond traditional reporting toward AI-powered analytics, conversational insights, and better business decisions.

You will own the evolution of key capabilities within our enterprise data platform, including curated data products, and AI-enabled analytics experiences such as conversational data exploration. Working with Data Engineering, Analytics, and business teams around the world, you will turn complex data into reliable, accessible products that help people answer questions, uncover opportunities, and act on insights.

This is a highly collaborative, technically focused product role that combines hands-on execution with forward-looking thinking. You will help shape how data is structured, connected, and delivered for both human and AI consumption, while keeping the platform reliable, scalable, and responsive to changing needs. Your work will directly influence how Condé Nast uses data and AI to understand audiences, evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and make more informed decisions.

  

**What You'll Do**

Enable BI and analytics platform evolution.

* Drive technical enhancements that support BI, insights enablement, and AI-powered data experiences, working with global stakeholders to align platform improvements with business needs.
* Partner with Analytics and business teams globally to identify recurring challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that improve data accessibility, self-service, and decision-making.
Manage engineering delivery, dependencies, release readiness, technical risks, and ongoing platform health; track measurable outcomes and communicate progress clearly.  

  

**Build trusted, AI-ready data products**

* Drive development of curated, business-ready Gold-layer data products that help teams move from fragmented reporting toward consistent, AI-powered insights and decision-making.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics, and Data Governance on data contracts, definitions, quality standards, lineage, documentation, certification, and monitoring.
Identify opportunities to enhance and manage existing data products, such as Identity Resolution and Single Customer View, in partnership with their stakeholders and owners.  

  

**Develop Conversational Analytics and AI capabilities.**

* Drive development and continuous improvement of conversational AI capabilities, including the curated datasets needed to support trusted natural-language analytics.
* Work with Analytics and Engineering to improve semantic definitions, metadata, context, and data readiness so AI-generated answers are accurate and useful.
Establish evaluation, testing, feedback, and monitoring practices for conversational data access; identify opportunities to expand conversational analytics, AI assistants, and other capabilities that make insights more accessible and actionable.  

  

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including significant work on data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or technical data products.
* Hands-on familiarity with Databricks and modern lakehouse architecture or comparable platforms is highly desirable; experience with Databricks Genie or comparable conversational analytics capabilities is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, pipelines, medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data quality, lineage, observability, and access controls.
* A track record of partnering closely with data engineers to deliver dependable platform capabilities, curated datasets, and technical improvements.
* Ability to turn broad goals into crisp requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and executable plans while exercising independent product judgment.
* Understanding of semantic and metrics layers, metadata, and the foundations needed for trustworthy AI-enabled analytics.
* Experience supporting BI and analytics tools and collaborating with analysts to solve recurring data-access and usability problems.
* Strong communication skills and experience working across global Engineering, Product, Analytics, and business teams.
* A systems mindset, curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, and a practical focus on platform reliability, adoption, and business value.
* Experience in media, publishing, advertising, subscriptions, or consumer data ecosystems is a plus.

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

job_description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

* Define and own licensing, entitlement & SKU structure for product and service sales and pricing.

* Own the customer portal and public APIs, including the customer user experience and interaction with our products and services through both the customer portal and public API usage.

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software on the fleet – from imaging and configuration, to release management and device upgrades, to fleet-wide monitoring and operations.

* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for appliance imaging & configuration, including build processes, manufacturer infrastructure deployment, fleet configuration & feature flag management, and zero-touch provisioning.

* Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.

* Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.

* Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.

* Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.

* Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.

* Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.

* Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and requirement documents, and support backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**

* 10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.

* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.

* Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.

* Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.  

  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Lead Product Owner
job_description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Position Overview:**

**Boeing Digital Services org** is currently looking for a **Senior Lead Product Owner** to join the team in **Bangalore, IN.** In this role you will drive product ownership excellence across a portfolio of maintenance and flight product suits. You will establish and scale product management practices, processes, standards, and governance across the organization while providing strategic direction and coaching to Product Owners and Development teams. You will serve as a trusted advisor to product, engineering, business, technology, and executive stakeholders. You will influence outcomes across multiple teams and products without direct authority and ensure that product decisions are driven by customer value, business impact, data, risk, and delivery feasibility.

The role combines enterprise-level Product Owner responsibilities with selected Product Manager responsibilities, including portfolio strategy, market analysis, product positioning, investment planning, customer discovery, business case development, and product lifecycle management. You will work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Greenfield Leadership, Data Scientists, and Architects to deliver product features and capabilities that keep AI and ML at the center of our solutions. You will be helping create new product offerings as well as modernizing systems that have been running the business for years, while building new ones designed to run it for years to come.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate portfolio-level product vision, strategy, objectives, outcomes, and roadmaps for aviation / MRO products, platforms, and capabilities.

* Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive offerings, emerging technologies, and internal capabilities to identify opportunities for new products, enhancements, modernization, consolidation, or retirement.

* Establish and maintain consistent product management and product ownership practices, processes, standards, governance, templates, and decision-making frameworks across the organization.

* Provide strategic direction, mentoring, and coaching to Product Owners, Product Managers, and Business Analysts in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Guide teams in translating customer and business needs into well-defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead portfolio-level prioritization and resolve cross-product dependencies, competing demands, sequencing decisions, resource constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

* Partner with customers and stakeholders to validate product concepts, business problems, solution alternatives, priorities, prototypes, and early product definitions.

* Define and monitor product and portfolio success measures, including customer satisfaction, adoption, operational performance, financial value, quality, delivery, and business outcomes.

* Represent the customer and business perspective throughout product development, Agile delivery, Program Increment planning, release planning, system demonstrations, and operational readiness activities.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, security, quality, operations, and support teams to evaluate technical options, integrations, scalability, technical debt, maintainability, resilience, and non-functional requirements.

* Communicate portfolio priorities, roadmap changes, investment recommendations, delivery progress, performance results, risks, and decisions to customers, stakeholders, and senior leadership while driving continuous improvement in product management maturity and value delivery.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* 15+ years relevant experience in software development including full-stack web development, experience with modern software product development, integration, and delivery

* Experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into software applications.

* Familiarity with AI-enabled product management tools and responsible use of generative AI for analysis, documentation, research, and decision support.

* Significant experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, business analysis, solution management, or a related discipline, including experience leading across multiple products.

* Extensive experience working in Agile and Scrum environments, including experience with SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Program Increment planning, and Product Owner/Product Manager responsibilities.

* Experience developing and implementing product management practices, operating models, governance frameworks, and standard processes across multiple teams or product areas.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and guide Product Owners and Product Managers in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Familiarity with latest tools & technology frameworks like JavaScript, JQuery, Java/J2EE, Azure App Services / Functions, Microservices etc.

* Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Configuration management, Automated testing, Monitoring and observability, Metrics and telemetry, and Infrastructure as code

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services and Azure DevOps.

* Experience with APIs, event-driven integrations, data platforms, analytics, and cloud-native architectures.

* Familiarity with Angular, React, React Native, or comparable web and mobile technologies.

* Understanding of mobile user experience principles and platform-specific design guidelines.

* Understanding of architectural styles like microservices, event-driven systems, monoliths, and serverless computing.

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience in Aerospace and/or Aviation and/or MRO domain is preferred

* Product management or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, SAFe Product Management

* Experience leading product management transformation, product operating model implementation, or Agile-at-scale adoption.

* Experience managing enterprise platforms, digital products, software ecosystems, or products involving complex integrations.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations to translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and uplift other engineers through pairing, code review, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

**Typical Education & Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 16 + years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g. Master 15+ Years ) related in computer science, aerospace or other closely related field.

**Relocation:**

This position does offer relocation within INDIA.

  
  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Nov. 29, 2026**

  
  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This is not an Export Control position.

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

**Visa Sponsorship**

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

**Shift**

Not a Shift Worker (India)

  
  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law.

We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

  

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

No matter where you are in life, our benefits help prepare you for the present and the future.

* Competitive base pay and incentive programs.
* Industry-leading tuition assistance program pays your institution directly.
* Resources and opportunities to grow your career.
* Up to $10,000 match when you support your favorite nonprofit organizations.

The role combines enterprise-level Product Owner responsibilities with selected Product Manager responsibilities, including portfolio strategy, market analysis, product positioning, investment planning, customer discovery, business case development, and product lifecycle management. You will work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Greenfield Leadership, Data Scientists, and Architects to deliver product features and capabilities that keep AI and ML at the center of our solutions. You will be helping create new product offerings as well as modernizing systems that have been running the business for years, while building new ones designed to run it for years to come.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate portfolio-level product vision, strategy, objectives, outcomes, and roadmaps for aviation / MRO products, platforms, and capabilities.

* Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive offerings, emerging technologies, and internal capabilities to identify opportunities for new products, enhancements, modernization, consolidation, or retirement.

* Establish and maintain consistent product management and product ownership practices, processes, standards, governance, templates, and decision-making frameworks across the organization.

* Provide strategic direction, mentoring, and coaching to Product Owners, Product Managers, and Business Analysts in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Guide teams in translating customer and business needs into well-defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead portfolio-level prioritization and resolve cross-product dependencies, competing demands, sequencing decisions, resource constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

* Partner with customers and stakeholders to validate product concepts, business problems, solution alternatives, priorities, prototypes, and early product definitions.

* Define and monitor product and portfolio success measures, including customer satisfaction, adoption, operational performance, financial value, quality, delivery, and business outcomes.

* Represent the customer and business perspective throughout product development, Agile delivery, Program Increment planning, release planning, system demonstrations, and operational readiness activities.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, security, quality, operations, and support teams to evaluate technical options, integrations, scalability, technical debt, maintainability, resilience, and non-functional requirements.

* Communicate portfolio priorities, roadmap changes, investment recommendations, delivery progress, performance results, risks, and decisions to customers, stakeholders, and senior leadership while driving continuous improvement in product management maturity and value delivery.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* 15+ years relevant experience in software development including full-stack web development, experience with modern software product development, integration, and delivery

* Experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into software applications.

* Familiarity with AI-enabled product management tools and responsible use of generative AI for analysis, documentation, research, and decision support.

* Significant experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, business analysis, solution management, or a related discipline, including experience leading across multiple products.

* Extensive experience working in Agile and Scrum environments, including experience with SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Program Increment planning, and Product Owner/Product Manager responsibilities.

* Experience developing and implementing product management practices, operating models, governance frameworks, and standard processes across multiple teams or product areas.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and guide Product Owners and Product Managers in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Familiarity with latest tools & technology frameworks like JavaScript, JQuery, Java/J2EE, Azure App Services / Functions, Microservices etc.

* Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Configuration management, Automated testing, Monitoring and observability, Metrics and telemetry, and Infrastructure as code

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services and Azure DevOps.

* Experience with APIs, event-driven integrations, data platforms, analytics, and cloud-native architectures.

* Familiarity with Angular, React, React Native, or comparable web and mobile technologies.

* Understanding of mobile user experience principles and platform-specific design guidelines.

* Understanding of architectural styles like microservices, event-driven systems, monoliths, and serverless computing.

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience in Aerospace and/or Aviation and/or MRO domain is preferred

* Product management or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, SAFe Product Management

* Experience leading product management transformation, product operating model implementation, or Agile-at-scale adoption.

* Experience managing enterprise platforms, digital products, software ecosystems, or products involving complex integrations.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations to translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and uplift other engineers through pairing, code review, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

title: Digital Product Manager - API Management Platforms (Apigee & IBM DataPower)
job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

Role Overview  
  
We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to drive the strategy, roadmap, adoption, and lifecycle management of our enterprise API Management platforms, including Apigee and IBM DataPower. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of product management, API ecosystem, integration architecture, platform governance, and stakeholder management experience.  
  
This role will be responsible for defining the product vision, prioritizing platform capabilities, driving modernization initiatives, enabling development teams, and ensuring the platform delivers secure, scalable, and reliable API services across the enterprise.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Define and own the product strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for API Management platforms including Apigee and IBM DataPower.
* Partner with business, architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to identify platform needs and translate them into prioritized product features and capabilities.
* Drive API platform adoption across enterprise teams by promoting best practices, standards, and self-service capabilities.
* Manage product backlogs, feature prioritization, release planning, and stakeholder communications.
* Establish API governance, security, lifecycle management, and onboarding standards.
* Lead modernization initiatives involving API gateways, cloud-native architectures, AI-driven integrations, and developer experience enhancements.
* Work closely with engineering teams to define platform requirements related to scalability, resiliency, performance, observability, and operational excellence.
* Define and track platform KPIs, adoption metrics, API consumption trends, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Collaborate with vendor partners and internal leadership to evaluate emerging technologies and platform enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops, platform analytics, and operational insights.
* Support budgeting, capacity planning, and investment decisions related to API management platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 12+ years of experience in Product Management, API Management, Integration Platforms, or Enterprise Middleware technologies.
* Strong experience with **Apigee API Management** and **IBM DataPower Gateway** platforms.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise platform products and driving platform adoption at scale.
* Deep understanding of API design, REST services, API lifecycle management, developer portals, and API governance.
* Experience working in Agile product management environments with responsibility for roadmap planning and backlog prioritization.
* Strong understanding of API security concepts including OAuth, JWT, mTLS, OpenID Connect, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or similar tools.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
* Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with AI Gateway capabilities and GenAI platform integrations.
* Exposure to Kong, MuleSoft, Azure API Management, or other API gateway technologies.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Relevant certifications in Product Management, Cloud, Apigee, or Agile methodologies.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**
----------------------------

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence decisions across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strategic thinker with a customer-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale platform transformation initiatives.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Increased API platform adoption and developer satisfaction.
* Improved platform reliability, scalability, and security posture.
* Delivery of roadmap commitments aligned to business priorities.
* Reduction in API onboarding time and operational overhead.
* Enhanced observability, governance, and compliance across the API ecosystem.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Yateesh B Gybgaa@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.
