**Team Overview**

The Technical Platform Manager (TPM) is responsible for driving the strategy, roadmap, adoption, governance, and delivery of enterprise platform services that enable secure, scalable, and efficient software development and infrastructure operations across the organization.
  
  
This role partners with platform service owners, engineering leaders, architecture, security, compliance, cloud engineering, and application development teams to define platform capabilities, establish operational excellence standards, drive platform adoption, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The TPM serves as a strategic leader who balances platform scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, and cost optimization while ensuring enterprise platform services continue to meet evolving business and technology needs.
  
  
Platform domains may include Data Ingestion, Data Quality, ETL, Web Applications, Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management , Developer Tooling, and Internal Developer Platforms.
  
  
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

**Data Platform Strategy & Roadmap Management**

* Define and manage the product roadmap for enterprise data acquisition, ingestion, correction, storage, and distribution platforms, including: Data Acquisition & Onboarding ServicesData Ingestion Pipelines (Batch and Real-Time)Data Quality & Validation ServicesData Correction Platforms (Consumer, Commercial, Fraud, MFI)Enterprise Data Store (EDS)Data Publishing & Distribution ServicesCDC, Streaming, and Event-Driven ArchitectureRedis and Low-Latency Data Access PlatformsData APIs and Data-as-a-Service Capabilities
* Establish product vision and strategy for enterprise data platforms aligned with business growth, regulatory requirements, and customer needs.
* Drive prioritisation of platform investments that improve data quality, scalability, timeliness, availability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product, Analytics, and Operations teams to define roadmap alignment, capability evolution, and technical strategy.
* Balance regulatory obligations, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and business-driven feature delivery.

**Data Product Adoption & Customer Success**

* Drive adoption of enterprise data platform capabilities across internal and external consumers.
* Develop deep understanding of data providers, operational users, analytics teams, product teams, and application consumers.
* Establish feedback loops with stakeholders to continuously improve data acquisition, correction, fulfilment, and data access experiences.
* Measure and report product adoption, service utilisation, customer satisfaction, data quality improvements, and business value realization.
* Champion self-service capabilities that enable data onboarding, monitoring, corrections, and operational management with minimal engineering intervention.

**Data Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Define and maintain operational frameworks governing data ingestion, validation, correction, retention, distribution, and lifecycle management.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics across: Data AvailabilityPipeline ThroughputData FreshnessData AccuracyData CompletenessData Quality ScoresOperational SLA ComplianceCustomer AdoptionPlatform Reliability
* Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Data Governance teams to ensure alignment with enterprise policies and regulatory obligations.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational resilience, platform scalability, automation, and reduction of manual intervention.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for data quality, performance, and availability incidents.

**Product Delivery & Program Leadership**

* Lead cross-functional delivery initiatives spanning multiple data and technology organizations.
* Own product planning activities including: RoadmapsBusiness casesPrioritizationScope managementRelease planningDependency management
* Facilitate Agile execution, Program Increment planning, roadmap reviews, stakeholder governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful delivery of data platform capabilities while balancing customer experience, operational excellence, security, and compliance requirements.
* Manage complex dependencies across ingestion, correction, storage, analytics, API, and fulfillment ecosystems.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate initiatives involving: Enterprise ArchitectureData ArchitectureInformation SecurityRegulatory & Compliance TeamsData GovernanceAnalytics & Data ScienceCloud & Infrastructure EngineeringApplication Development TeamsBusiness Product OwnersOperations & Support Organizations
* Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities.
* Influence enterprise-wide decisions regarding data architecture, governance frameworks, platform standards, and operating models.
* Act as the primary product leader for enterprise data platform capabilities and strategic modernization initiatives.

  

* 8+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, Technical Program Manager, Platform Product Manager, or equivalent leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, data products, ingestion services, or data management solutions.
* Experience defining and executing data platform strategy, roadmap development, adoption plans, and product lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems including: Data AcquisitionData IngestionData Quality ManagementData Correction WorkflowsMaster Data ManagementData DistributionData Governance
* Experience working with both real-time and batch processing architectures.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture patterns including: Event-driven architectureStreaming platformsData pipelinesAPI-driven integrationsData products
* Experience managing products supporting multiple internal and external customers.
* Experience establishing and reporting product KPIs and operational metrics.
* Proven ability to influence executive leadership, engineering organizations, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale, highly regulated, enterprise data initiatives.
* Strong ownership mindset with experience managing risks, dependencies, and commitments across multiple delivery teams.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  

  
  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

**Required Technical Skills**

* Enterprise Data Platforms and Data Warehousing concepts.
* Data Ingestion Technologies including: KafkaCDC PlatformsStreaming SolutionsETL/ELT FrameworksEvent-Driven Architectures
* Enterprise databases including: PostgreSQLSQL ServerOracleNoSQL Technologies
* Caching and low-latency data access platforms: RedisDistributed Caching PlatformsIn-memory Data Technologies
* API Management and Data Services: RESTgRPCEvent APIsData Service Layers
* Cloud platforms: AWSAzureGCP
* Data Quality and Observability platforms.
* Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage concepts.
* Agile delivery tools including Jira, Confluence, and enterprise planning platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise credit, risk, fraud, identity, or financial data ecosystems.
* Knowledge of consumer, commercial, fraud, or alternative data acquisition and fulfilment processes.
* Experience with data correction and dispute management platforms.
* Experience with Data Mesh, Data Product, or Data-as-a-Service operating models.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks governing data management and consumer information.
* Experience leading enterprise data modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience presenting platform strategy, data quality trends, adoption metrics, and business outcomes to senior executive leadership.
* Strong understanding of data operations, service reliability, and operational excellence practices
  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

  

The People Technology Foundation Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Foundation portfolio, ensuring that core workforce data, employee lifecycle capabilities, organisational structures and supporting technologies are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.

  

Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function. You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers across a portfolio initially comprising SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include capabilities such as Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.

  

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Foundation portfolio, ensuring it delivers measurable business value today while evolving to meet future organisational needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the People Technology Foundation product strategy, roadmap, backlog and priorities, ensuring investment and delivery remain aligned to business objectives and long-term technology direction.
* Act as the accountable owner for the Foundation portfolio, including SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation capabilities.
* Balance immediate operational priorities with quarterly objectives, 12-18 month roadmap commitments and longer-term capability evolution, ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable value today while supporting future organisational needs.
* Lead and develop the Foundation product team, providing direction, coaching, prioritisation and performance management while building product, platform and delivery capability across the Foundation domain.
* Partner with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead and participate in intake, demand and prioritisation processes, assessing Foundation-related incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and project requests.
* Own delivery outcomes across the Foundation portfolio, determining the most appropriate delivery approach through internal capability, blended delivery teams and partner-led delivery models.
* Define expected benefits, success measures and business outcomes, monitoring value realisation to ensure technology investment delivers measurable benefit.
* Own the Foundation product data model, configuration, business rules and information structures, ensuring workforce data structures support business processes, reporting, compliance, workforce planning and future capability requirements.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders, balancing local requirements with global standards, strategic priorities and product direction.
* Lead and develop the Foundation People Technology Community, creating structured engagement, feedback, knowledge-sharing and adoption mechanisms across regions and stakeholder groups.
* Drive adoption of leading practices across the Foundation portfolio, continuously assessing technology developments, market trends and industry approaches to improve product performance, user experience and business value.
* Monitor product health, service performance, adoption, usability and operational effectiveness, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and optimisation.
* Remain accountable for the quality, completeness and maintenance of Foundation product documentation, ensuring governance, audit, support and operational requirements are met.
* Own product relationships with support and delivery partners, reviewing commitments and outcomes, challenging recommendations where appropriate and driving effective knowledge transfer to build internal capability.
* Partner with architecture, security, data and integration teams to ensure solutions remain sustainable, compliant and aligned to enterprise standards and future technology direction.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including product ownership, roadmap planning, capability development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities for enterprise technology products.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, systems or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Experience translating business requirements, operational challenges and strategic objectives into product outcomes and measurable value.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, organisational structures, employee lifecycle processes and Foundation capabilities.
* Experience managing product demand, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience working with business stakeholders, regional teams, technology teams and third-party suppliers to deliver business outcomes.
* Experience managing partner-delivered services and balancing delivery through internal teams, blended teams and external providers.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing governance, product processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy and roadmap planning.
* Experience using product performance, service performance, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continuous improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable:**

  

* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise business application portfolios.
* Experience supporting OpenText or enterprise document and records management solutions.
* Experience supporting Time Off, Absence Management or Workforce Administration capabilities.
* Experience supporting Payroll technologies, payroll integrations or payroll-related HR processes.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, user groups, super-user networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience with application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management or service governance.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.
  

**Qualifications & Certifications - Desirable**

**Product**

  

* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Certification
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications, particularly Employee Central Payroll, Time Management, Platform Foundations or Position Management.
  

**Product & Delivery**

* SAFe Product Manager / Product Owner
* AgilePM
* Scrum Product Owner
* Scrum Master

**Service Management**

ITIL Foundation or higher certification

  

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore,Hyderabad
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023

**Job Description**

Associate Product Manager, Suite Experience

**Summary/objective**

isolved is modernizing the user experience across its HCM platform, built on a shared design system. In this role you will work from our Hyderabad office as the day-to-day product owner for three development teams, each building new pages and experiences for a different product area at the same time.

The design system is already in place, so the job is less about designing from scratch and more about building the right thing correctly. You will make sure each new page does everything the current one does, works for every user role, and handles real-world edge cases. You will also answer the many small product and UX questions that come up during development. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs, planning, and decisions.

**Core Job Duties**

* Document how current pages work, including fields, actions, user permissions, and edge cases, so nothing is lost when they are rebuilt
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for three development teams working in parallel
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that cover page behavior, validation, error and empty states, role-based access, and accessibility
* Answer day-to-day product and UX questions from developers, using the existing design system and escalating only where a new pattern is needed
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and sign off before release
* Manage feature flags for your teams' work, within the release plan set by the Group Product Manager
* Take special care with compliance-sensitive workflows, where a missing date, notice, or record creates legal risk
* Keep roadmap items current in our planning tools (Airfocus, Azure DevOps)
* Work with US-based product leadership, support, and QA across time zones, through overlapping meetings and a daily written handoff

**Job Complexity**

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Emerging understanding of broader organizational context and goals. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position.

**Interaction**

Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise.

**Supervision**

Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

**Experience**

Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience.

**Scope**

N/A

**Discretion**

N/A

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in business analysis or a related technical role with direct involvement in defining requirements and working with engineering teams
* Experience as a product owner, product manager, or business analyst on web applications
* Strong user story and acceptance criteria writing in an Agile/Scrum environment
* Attention to detail. You notice the missing field, the unhandled error, or the wrong permission.
* Comfort working from a design system and making sensible UX calls within it
* The ability to keep three teams moving at once and to prioritize under pressure

* Clear written English. Much of the collaboration with US teams happens in writing.
* Availability for regular overlap with US business hours

**Preferred Qualfication**

* HCM domain knowledge, especially in one or more of: COBRA or benefits administration, applicant tracking (ATS), or learning management (LMS)
* Experience with UI modernization or re-platforming projects
* Familiarity with Figma, feature flag management, and accessibility (WCAG) basics
* Experience working with distributed teams across time zones
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude to speed up requirements, prototyping, or documentation work

**Physical Demands**

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.

**Travel Required**

No

**FLSA Classification**

Exempt

**Location**

Nearshore/Hyderabad

**Effective** **Date:** 1/1/2023

**Internal Job Title**
======================

Associate Product Manager, Suite Experience

**About isolved**
=================

isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers - who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HRpayroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.

isolved is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and open-minded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. Visit www.isolvedhcm.com/careers for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. Visit www.isolvedeebenefits.com for a comprehensive list of our employee total rewards offerings.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

You will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

**Responsibilities:**

● Support the product roadmap and backlog for web and mobile platforms  
● Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories ● Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution  
● Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking  
● Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics  
● Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials  
● Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

**Required Skills and Traits:**

● Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field  
● 1–3 years of product experience in web and mobile app environments  
● Strong analytical skills and understanding of product metrics using Google Analytics  
● Experience with Zoho Sprints and familiarity with tools like JIRA, Figma, or Trello  
● Knowledge of project management and the complete product development lifecycle  
● Ability to lead ideation sessions and define clear user and business requirements  
● Good written and verbal communication skills  
● Experience working with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders  
● Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver product demos with clear understanding of functionality and user workflows

**Preferred Qualifications:**

● Prior involvement in consumer-facing digital platforms  
● Understanding of APIs, technical constraints, and platform differences  
● Experience working with cloud-based products or services is a plus  
● Certification in Product Management from recognized institutions (e.g., Airtribe, Product School, Hello PM or equivalent)

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your total experience in product maagement (except freelancing/part time roles) ?
* Are you currently residing or willing to relocate to Goa ?
* Are willing to work 6 days a week onsite (Goa) ?
* Please mention your current/last fixed CTC (in lacs per annum).
* Please mention your expected CTC (in lacs per annum).
* How soon can you join (please include your notice period and relocation time needed for joining) ?

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Digital Product Manager - Procure To Pay
job_description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-259351 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Nov. 11, 2026 CATEGORY: Procurement

About Amgen

If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.

**About the role**
==================

**Role description**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This role is the business product owner for technology, data and AI across Amgen’s Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, from intake and requisition through purchase order (PO), receipt, invoice and payment. It translates the Global Procurement roadmap into a prioritized portfolio that improves automation, user experience and financial control.

Based in Hyderabad, this role connects intake and guided buying, SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, supplier onboarding and contract management. It leads business priorities, requirements and acceptance with P2P process owners, Finance/AP, Technology and delivery partners across the US, Europe and JAPAC.

Finance/AP and Treasury retain payment authorization and execution; Technology leads architecture, engineering and technical operations. The P2P Technology Lead aligns partners on outcomes, commitments and escalations.

**Roles and responsibilities**
------------------------------

### **P2P technology strategy and roadmap**

* Own the P2P product vision and technology roadmap within the Global Procurement technology and AI plan; prioritize investments against business value, risk, total cost of ownership and delivery dependencies.

* Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.
* ;">Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.;">Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.

* Evaluate next-generation SAP Ariba and embedded AI capabilities against business needs, release availability, integration readiness and adoption costs; recommend where to use native capability or a partner solution.

* Define touchless processing by process stage, with agreed eligibility, exclusions and controls. For invoices, distinguish processing without manual intervention from invoice receipt to ready-to-pay status from payment authorization and execution.

### **Platform integration and ERP readiness**

* Lead business requirements for connected intake, procurement, supplier and contract workflows; ensure accurate transfer of approvals, purchasing data and transaction status across systems.

* Partner with the SAP S/4HANA program on open-PO transition, supplier master data, tax determination and e-invoicing; lead P2P business readiness for data reconciliation, end-to-end testing and cutover.

* Champion buying-channel compliance, including No PO–No Pay where applicable, guided routing, catalogs and approved exception handling in line with policy.

### **AI automation and data foundations**

* Shape and scale P2P automation and AI use cases, including requisition validation, invoice capture and matching, receipt workflows and duplicate-payment detection; define baselines, acceptance criteria and pilot-to-scale decisions.

* Partner with Technology and control owners to define AI access limits, evaluation criteria, human review and audit trails; monitor errors and false positives, with escalation and fallback procedures.

* Manage technology vendors and pilot partners through scoping, value validation and scale decisions; review business performance, service commitments and ongoing costs with the relevant owners.

* Define P2P data requirements for the enterprise data platform; work with data owners on quality, common identifiers, lineage and access so requisition, PO, receipt, invoice and payment records can be reconciled and analyzed.

### **Portfolio governance and delivery**

* Represent P2P in Source-to-Pay portfolio and program increment (PI) planning; maintain a prioritized backlog with clear business requirements, acceptance criteria, capacity, dependencies and committed or deferred scope.

* Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* ;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.

* Agree KPI baselines, definitions, targets and owners with P2P and Finance/AP. Track touchless invoice rate, e-invoice adoption, first-pass match rate, cycle time, cost per invoice and on-time payment, alongside adoption and service performance.

* Report realized benefits with Finance validation, separating cost savings, capacity released, working-capital impact and recovered cash; avoid double counting benefits across initiatives.

### **Platform operations and controls**

* Coordinate business response to critical P2P incidents with Technology and support partners; prioritize restoration, root-cause fixes and the elimination of recurring exceptions.

* Embed SOX requirements, segregation of duties, approval controls, audit evidence and data protection in requirements and testing; support control owners in resolving technology-related audit findings.

* Agree business release and service-readiness criteria, including regression testing, support handover and continuity arrangements for critical buying and invoicing workflows.

### **Stakeholder engagement and change**

* Partner closely with P2P global process owners, Finance/AP, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to convert pain points into prioritized, policy-aligned solutions.
* ;">Partner closely with P2P global process owners, Finance/AP, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to convert pain points into prioritized, policy-aligned solutions.;">Partner closely with P2P global process owners, Finance/AP, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to convert pain points into prioritized, policy-aligned solutions.

* Lead business readiness, supplier enablement, training and hypercare with change partners; use adoption, user feedback and exception trends to improve the buying and invoicing experience.

* Lead and develop business analysts and digital product associates; set clear accountabilities, coach product and P2P skills, and coordinate managed-service and technology delivery resources.

**What we expect of you**
=========================

**Must have skills**
--------------------

About Amgen

If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.

**About the role**
==================

**Role description**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This role is the business product owner for technology, data and AI across Amgen’s Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, from intake and requisition through purchase order (PO), receipt, invoice and payment. It translates the Global Procurement roadmap into a prioritized portfolio that improves automation, user experience and financial control.

Based in Hyderabad, this role connects intake and guided buying, SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, supplier onboarding and contract management. It leads business priorities, requirements and acceptance with P2P process owners, Finance/AP, Technology and delivery partners across the US, Europe and JAPAC.

Finance/AP and Treasury retain payment authorization and execution; Technology leads architecture, engineering and technical operations. The P2P Technology Lead aligns partners on outcomes, commitments and escalations.

**Roles and responsibilities**
------------------------------

### **P2P technology strategy and roadmap**

* Own the P2P product vision and technology roadmap within the Global Procurement technology and AI plan; prioritize investments against business value, risk, total cost of ownership and delivery dependencies.

* Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.

* Evaluate next-generation SAP Ariba and embedded AI capabilities against business needs, release availability, integration readiness and adoption costs; recommend where to use native capability or a partner solution.

* Define touchless processing by process stage, with agreed eligibility, exclusions and controls. For invoices, distinguish processing without manual intervention from invoice receipt to ready-to-pay status from payment authorization and execution.

### **Platform integration and ERP readiness**

* Lead business requirements for connected intake, procurement, supplier and contract workflows; ensure accurate transfer of approvals, purchasing data and transaction status across systems.

* Partner with the SAP S/4HANA program on open-PO transition, supplier master data, tax determination and e-invoicing; lead P2P business readiness for data reconciliation, end-to-end testing and cutover.

* Champion buying-channel compliance, including No PO–No Pay where applicable, guided routing, catalogs and approved exception handling in line with policy.

### **AI automation and data foundations**

* Shape and scale P2P automation and AI use cases, including requisition validation, invoice capture and matching, receipt workflows and duplicate-payment detection; define baselines, acceptance criteria and pilot-to-scale decisions.

* Partner with Technology and control owners to define AI access limits, evaluation criteria, human review and audit trails; monitor errors and false positives, with escalation and fallback procedures.

* Manage technology vendors and pilot partners through scoping, value validation and scale decisions; review business performance, service commitments and ongoing costs with the relevant owners.

* Define P2P data requirements for the enterprise data platform; work with data owners on quality, common identifiers, lineage and access so requisition, PO, receipt, invoice and payment records can be reconciled and analyzed.

### **Portfolio governance and delivery**

* Represent P2P in Source-to-Pay portfolio and program increment (PI) planning; maintain a prioritized backlog with clear business requirements, acceptance criteria, capacity, dependencies and committed or deferred scope.

* Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* ;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.

* Agree KPI baselines, definitions, targets and owners with P2P and Finance/AP. Track touchless invoice rate, e-invoice adoption, first-pass match rate, cycle time, cost per invoice and on-time payment, alongside adoption and service performance.

* Report realized benefits with Finance validation, separating cost savings, capacity released, working-capital impact and recovered cash; avoid double counting benefits across initiatives.

### **Platform operations and controls**

* Coordinate business response to critical P2P incidents with Technology and support partners; prioritize restoration, root-cause fixes and the elimination of recurring exceptions.

* Embed SOX requirements, segregation of duties, approval controls, audit evidence and data protection in requirements and testing; support control owners in resolving technology-related audit findings.

* Agree business release and service-readiness criteria, including regression testing, support handover and continuity arrangements for critical buying and invoicing workflows.

job_description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Product TPM team operates at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery, enabling the successful development and rollout of scalable, customer-centric solutions. At the Consultant (P03) level, the team is composed of Technical Product Managers who own feature-level delivery while collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
  
The team functions within an Agile framework, ensuring continuous delivery of high-quality product increments through iterative development, sprint cycles, and regular feedback loops. Each TPM is responsible for managing specific product modules or features, contributing to the broader product roadmap while aligning execution with organizational goals and customer needs.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The Consultant (P03) – Technical Product Management (TPM) role is responsible for driving the end-to-end delivery of technology-enabled product features by effectively bridging business requirements with engineering execution. The role combines product ownership, technical understanding, and Agile delivery to ensure the development of scalable, high-quality solutions aligned with customer needs and organizational priorities.

At this level, the TPM owns feature-level execution, collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, and contributes to product strategy and roadmap under guidance from senior product leaders.
  
  
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Ownership**

* Own and manage assigned product features or modules from concept to delivery
* Define detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain the product backlog
* Prioritize deliverables based on business value, customer impact, and feasibility

**2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Support**

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and execution
* Align feature development with overall product vision and business objectives
* Incorporate stakeholder input, user feedback, and analytics insights

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
* Work closely with engineering teams on solution design and implementation
* Assess technical trade-offs, dependencies, and constraints
* Ensure adherence to scalability, security, and performance standards

**4. Agile Delivery Execution**

* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retrospectives)
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of product increments
* Support continuous improvement in development and delivery processes

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and UX/design teams
* Act as the primary point of contact for owned features
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively

**6. Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and track KPIs for product features
* Use product analytics and user insights to drive improvements
* Optimize product performance, usability, and adoption

**7. Product Lifecycle Support**

* Support the full product lifecycle including requirement gathering, development, testing, and release
* Assist in documentation, training, and user adoption initiatives

Ensure smooth rollout and continuous enhancement of features

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

The ideal candidate should have 5–8 years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management, or software/program delivery roles, with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle and Agile methodologies. They should possess solid knowledge of SDLC, ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, and familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with Agile certifications (CSPO/CSM) considered an added advantage.

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

  
  

TransUnion Job Title

  
  
  
Consultant, Product Management

author: Hiring Manager
role: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
role_title: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
title: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications and data-driven solutions that power the financial services industry. We help businesses improve operational efficiency, enhance client experiences and make better decisions through innovative technology and data solutions.

At Broadridge, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built around collaboration, innovation, accountability and continuous learning, where employees have the opportunity to work on meaningful, business-critical solutions and build long-term careers.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The **Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics** owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

The role also focuses on monitoring, issue resolution, process standardization, data governance, and stakeholder communication, while guiding Level 1 resources and working closely with Level 2/3 IT support teams to drive long-term stability and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead product discovery by gathering requirements from stakeholders, users, and technical teams.
* Design, implement, and govern data quality controls, reconciliation frameworks, and exception management mechanisms.
* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products aligned with business goals.
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, and strategic fit.
* Identify high-impact opportunities where data products can improve decision-making, operations, or customer experience.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business leaders to deliver data products.
* Drive implementation of data products in data platforms, dashboards, semantic layers, self-service analytics tools, APIs, and ML-enabled solutions.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure adoption, usability, data quality, and business impact.
* Champion data quality, governance, documentation, and trust across products.
* Ensure data products are intuitive, accessible, and fit for purpose for target users.
* Manage stakeholder communication, expectations, timelines and risks.
* Continuously improve products through feedback, usage insights, and performance measurement.
* Support data ownership, governance frameworks, privacy, and compliance requirements where applicable.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

* 7–10+ years of experience in data product management, data, analytics, or platform delivery.
* Extensive hands-on and architectural experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms handling high-volume, business-critical Finance data.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics workflows, and reporting ecosystems.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with data governance, metrics design, and data quality principles.
* Experience delivering internal or external data-driven products.
* Advanced proficiency in **SQL and Snowflake**, including performance tuning, complex validations, reconciliation logic, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with data warehousing, ETL frameworks, and cloud data platforms.
* Preferred understanding of enterprise Finance systems and ERP platforms such as **Oracle (EBS / Fusion)** and **SAP (ECC / S/4HANA)**.
* Proven experience working with workload scheduling and automation tools such as **Apache Airflow and Control-M**.
* Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, controls, and reconciliation frameworks in Finance environments.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
* Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
* Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

* **Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions:** Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
* **Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology:** Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
* **Drive transformation:** Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
* **Collaborative environment:** Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
* **Growth & learning:** Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
* **Global exposure:** Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
* **Innovation-driven culture:** Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

**Join Us**
-----------

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.**

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

* Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
* Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
* Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

* **Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions:** Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
* **Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology:** Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
* **Drive transformation:** Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
* **Collaborative environment:** Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
* **Growth & learning:** Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
* **Global exposure:** Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
* **Innovation-driven culture:** Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

**Join Us**
-----------

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.**

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
